name: opentrain_request_hire_batch
title: Request one batch hire approval
description: Request one human approval for 1–20 same-job applicants. Never hires or funds directly. Initial hire uses the bid; another requested rate needs worker acceptance. Stable key required; human edits/deselects/confirms at approvalUrl. POST replays its receipt; GET reads current status. Distinct pending reviews per actor and job are capped (409 PENDING_BATCH_LIMIT with limit and pendingCount); a slot frees when the human confirms or declines one, or when retention declines one left expired for 90 days.

name: opentrain_get_hire_batch
title: Read batch hire progress
description: Read every original item outcome, contract mapping and pending rate consent. Observational: never confirms, funds, expires or resumes work.

name: opentrain_quiz_form_image_prepare
title: Reserve a private quiz authoring image and mint the signed single-PUT grant
description: Quiz authoring image step 1/3 (registry op project_todos.quizzes.forms.images.upload): reserves a private image for a job-scoped quiz form (PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF, at most 5 MiB) and returns a fresh signed single-PUT grant (2 h, upsert disabled). PUT the exact bytes to upload.signedPut.url with upload.signedPut.headers, then finalize. The same idempotencyKey replays the same reservation with a new grant. The grant is a SECRET: use it once, never store or log it. Employer-only: needs project_todos:write (list: project_todos:read), a claimed account and access to the form's job; a missing, foreign, other-job, archived or organization-level form is one 404. Images are private: no storage path or delivery URL is returned, and bytes never travel in a request body or as base64.

name: opentrain_quiz_form_image_finalize
title: Verify the uploaded quiz image server-side and commit it READY
description: Quiz authoring image step 3/3: the server reads the stored bytes and checks the reserved size, magic bytes, dimensions, pixel count and SHA-256 (pass expectedSha256 to cross-check) before it commits the image READY. UPLOAD_INCOMPLETE means nothing is stored yet; CHECKSUM_MISMATCH leaves the reservation PENDING; INVALID bytes need a new reservation. Then put `imageNode` into a question's rich content in the draft (form_update_draft) and set `attrs.alt` to a short description, or `attrs.decorative: true` for an image that carries no meaning. The draft accepts only READY images of the same form or job. Employer-only: needs project_todos:write (list: project_todos:read), a claimed account and access to the form's job; a missing, foreign, other-job, archived or organization-level form is one 404. Images are private: no storage path or delivery URL is returned, and bytes never travel in a request body or as base64.

name: opentrain_quiz_form_images_list
title: List the private authoring images of one job-scoped quiz form
description: List the private authoring images of one job-scoped quiz form, newest first (at most 100; truncated says more exist): status (PENDING until finalized, then READY), MIME type, size, dimensions and verified sha256. Employer-only: needs project_todos:write (list: project_todos:read), a claimed account and access to the form's job; a missing, foreign, other-job, archived or organization-level form is one 404. Images are private: no storage path or delivery URL is returned, and bytes never travel in a request body or as base64.

name: opentrain_resolve_candidate_message_route
title: Resolve current candidate message route
description: Resolve the existing DM for a proposal (optionally jobId), or jobId plus userId. Requires messages:read and employer job/conversation access. Current ACTIVE/REACTIVATED participation routes to Job DM; no current hire routes to Proposal DM, never historical HIRED. Missing/ambiguous state refuses. Read the conversation before sending; preserve the complete route for opentrain_send_candidate_message. Never creates or repairs conversations.

name: opentrain_send_candidate_message
title: Send to a reviewed candidate route
description: Send once to an existing reviewed candidate DM. Pass the complete route from opentrain_resolve_candidate_message_route, content, confirm:true and a stable idempotencyKey. Requires messages:read/write, messaging rollout and claimed employer access. Hire state and latest root/thread message are rechecked atomically; stale or ambiguous routes refuse without sending. Never silently reroutes or duplicates. After an uncertain outcome retry only the SAME route, content and key; never auto-refresh or use a new key. Returns the route, messageId and replayed.

name: opentrain_search_jobs
title: Search Open OpenTrain Jobs
description: Find open jobs on OpenTrain, a marketplace for paid AI training and data work such as labeling, evaluation and subject-matter review. Use it when someone looks for this kind of work. Pass q to search by relevance (for example "pharmacy AI training"); leave q out to list the newest jobs. Filter by category, domain, language, country or payType. Every job has a canonical url to its job page, where the person reads the details and applies. Anonymous and read-only: it returns public job listings only.

q.description: Free-text search, ranked by relevance. Leave out to list the newest jobs.

domain.description: Subject-matter domain slug (see the same facets list).

language.description: A language the work needs, as a tag such as en, es or fil.

country.description: Two-letter ISO country of the person, such as US. Jobs with no country restriction are included.

payType.description: Payment type: hourly, fixed price or per label.

cursor.description: nextCursor from the previous page of the same search.

url.description: Canonical job page (https://www.opentrain.ai/jobs/<slug>--<id>/). Link this exactly; the person applies there.

countries.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes. Empty means the job lists no country restriction.

hourlyMin.description: Hourly pay, low end (USD). A single rate is min = max.

hourlyIsUpTo.description: True when the hourly figures are a ceiling ("up to"), not the stated pay.

validThrough.description: ISO 8601 timestamp until which the job is listed as open.

nextCursor.description: Pass as cursor for the next page; null when there are no more results.

name: opentrain_get_job
title: Get an OpenTrain Job
description: Read one OpenTrain job in full: pay, languages, countries, skills and the plain-text description. Use it after opentrain_search_jobs, or when someone shares an OpenTrain job link. Pass id, or url as the job page link (https://www.opentrain.ai/jobs/<slug>--<id>/). A job that is closed or not public returns status "closed". Anonymous and read-only.

id.description: Job id from a search result.

url.description: Canonical job page (https://www.opentrain.ai/jobs/<slug>--<id>/). Link this exactly; the person applies there.

countries.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes. Empty means the job lists no country restriction.

hourlyMin.description: Hourly pay, low end (USD). A single rate is min = max.

hourlyIsUpTo.description: True when the hourly figures are a ceiling ("up to"), not the stated pay.

validThrough.description: ISO 8601 timestamp until which the job is listed as open.

applyMode.description: opentrain: the person applies through OpenTrain. external: the person signs up on OpenTrain first, then finishes on another site.

name: opentrain_search_hub
title: Search the OpenTrain Contributable Hub
description: Search the public Contributable Hub registry of datasets, RL environments, evals, and benchmarks. Anonymous and read-only; held-out benchmark material is never returned.

name: opentrain_get_hub_entry
title: Get an OpenTrain Hub Entry
description: Fetch one Contributable Hub entry by slug: attribution, verbatim license, versions, sealed-set counts (held-out bodies never included), and the human-verified leaderboard when present.

name: opentrain_auth_status
title: Check OpenTrain Auth Status
description: Verify the linked OpenTrain API token and return the authenticated actor, non-secret token identity (ID, label, masked preview, stable fingerprint), access mode, effective token scopes, account context, and restricted-surface diagnostics (e.g. whether admin-balance hiring is usable and the exact safe remediation when it is not).

name: opentrain_capabilities
title: Discover OpenTrain Capabilities
description: Read-only, ungated capability discovery for the linked token: which public-API features are enabled, plus the agentSurfaces block reporting every agent operation family as disabled, rollout_gated, unauthorized, or available with required vs granted scopes and per-operation authorized flags (a read-only token sees mutations as unauthorized even in an available family). Call this when a tool returns a feature-disabled or scope error, or before planning a multi-step flow.

name: opentrain_get_candidate_dossier
title: Get a Candidate Dossier
description:
Demo and sample rows (tour fixtures, the docs-demo seed, DEMO_* accounts, Bubble-era onboarding Sample Job engagements) are always excluded (DEV-2924). Read the privacy-safe candidate dossier linked to an OpenTrain proposal: masked profile, proposal summary, AI-interview summary, verification verdicts (incl. identity assurance and current-location decision detail), factual engagement disposition, neutral links, and review/contract roll-ups with a stable asOf timestamp plus explicit availability/missing/redactions/provenance metadata. Optional strict evidence:"full" (DEV-2923) adds ten bounded metadata-only evidence families (cap 25 items each, truthful truncation, typed continuation); omitted means concise with evidence null. Requires candidate_dossier:read, the default-off candidate-dossier agent surface, and a claimed account. Hidden or banned candidates read as not found; contact details, raw resumes, government IDs, message bodies/participants, provider/session references, and assessment contents or runtime internals (including cross-buyer private assessments) are never returned, and full evidence carries no compensation amounts and no coordinates/IP/ASN/timezone data. Candidate-authored free text (profile fields and the AI-interview summary) is sanitized with explicit [REDACTED_*] placeholders recorded as PRIVACY_MASKED redactions.
CandidateProjectEligibility is a stored job-scoped participation summary, separate from person-level identity, time-bounded currentLocation, proposal-time location snapshots, and screening results. null means no participation record is available, not eligible. evaluatedAt is the stored decision timestamp (or last evaluation), not the time of this read; use it as the freshness signal. reasonCodes are diagnostic reasons from that decision, not independent vetoes: ELIGIBLE can coexist with FULL_ID_REQUIRED or a location REVIEW_REQUIRED result under a non-enforced policy. Reads do not reevaluate the decision's freshness or grant access; active overrides are filtered for expiry at read time, and protected writes enforce current policy. DECISION_STALE is added only by the access guard; SCOPE_NOT_FOUND, SCOPE_MISMATCH and SCOPE_USER_MISMATCH are scope-resolution errors. These four codes are not emitted in this read. Always inspect identity, currentLocation and reasons separately; never infer verified identity, fresh location or permission to hire/work from this summary alone.
ELIGIBLE: The stored job-participation decision allows participation and the participation is not ON_HOLD. This is not proof of verified identity or current location: a non-enforced (including SHADOW) policy records allowed=true even when reasons identify unmet requirements.
ON_HOLD: The stored participation is ON_HOLD and no active override is projected. Do not treat it as cleared for protected work; follow the canonical hold/review flow.
INELIGIBLE: No active override or ON_HOLD state is projected, and the current decision is missing or records allowed=false. This is a job-scoped participation result, not a hiring-quality verdict or a permanent ban.
OVERRIDE_ACTIVE: An unrevoked, unexpired participation override exists. It takes precedence in this summary, but can be action-scoped; it is not blanket permission and does not turn identity or location into verified evidence.
reasonCodes catalog (diagnostic, not provider error strings):
CURRENT_LOCATION_ALLOWED: Current credible location evidence satisfies the job location policy.
CURRENT_LOCATION_OUTSIDE_ALLOWED_COUNTRIES: Credible current evidence is outside the allowed countries; confidence/repetition determines review versus a confirmed mismatch. This requires OpenTrain review: contact OpenTrain support, and the worker must supply new evidence.
CLIENT_RESTRICTED_COUNTRY: Credible current evidence places the person in a client-restricted country. Seek human review of disputed evidence; do not bypass the client restriction.
CLIENT_RESTRICTED_REGION: Credible current evidence places the person in a client-restricted region. Seek human review of disputed evidence; do not bypass the client restriction.
ANONYMIZED_OR_AMBIGUOUS_SIGNAL: Current network/location evidence is anonymized or ambiguous and cannot establish allowed physical presence. Ask the worker to sign in to the OpenTrain app from their current location without a VPN or proxy. Under a non-enforced policy the status stays ELIGIBLE and this code is diagnostic; the decision re-evaluates on the next signal from the worker once hired, or at the next job action while still recruiting. Under an enforced policy this decision has already opened a location hold that a new signal does not clear on its own, so contact OpenTrain support for review once the worker has signed in.
CONFLICTING_CURRENT_SIGNALS: Credible current signals disagree on country alongside an outside-allowed-country signal. This requires OpenTrain review: contact OpenTrain support, and the worker must supply new evidence.
INSUFFICIENT_CURRENT_EVIDENCE: There is not enough usable current evidence to establish location. Ask the worker to sign in to the OpenTrain app from their current location. Under a non-enforced policy the status stays ELIGIBLE and this code is diagnostic; the decision re-evaluates on the next signal from the worker once hired, or at the next job action while still recruiting. Under an enforced policy this decision has already opened a location hold that a new signal does not clear on its own, so contact OpenTrain support for review once the worker has signed in.
STALE_LOCATION_EVIDENCE: Recorded location observations are no longer usable as current evidence. Ask the worker to sign in to the OpenTrain app from their current location. Under a non-enforced policy the status stays ELIGIBLE and this code is diagnostic; the decision re-evaluates on the next signal from the worker once hired, or at the next job action while still recruiting. Under an enforced policy this decision has already opened a location hold that a new signal does not clear on its own, so contact OpenTrain support for review once the worker has signed in.
ACTIVE_HOLD_REQUIRES_REVIEW: An existing location hold needs explicit review/challenge; a later passive signal alone does not clear it.
PROVIDER_EVIDENCE_UNAVAILABLE: Current provider evidence is unavailable; independent usable evidence has not established location. Wait for provider recovery or seek human review; do not treat an outage as clearance.
FULL_ID_REQUIRED: Full identity is required by the job policy but has not been verified or requested. Request full identity verification from the proposal in the OpenTrain app; the worker then completes it. No public API or MCP operation can request it.
FULL_ID_IN_PROGRESS: Required full identity verification is requested or in progress; it is not yet verified. Wait for the pending verification result.
FULL_ID_FAILED: Required full identity verification failed. Seek human review before any permitted retry; do not infer clearance.
FULL_ID_EXPIRED: Required full identity verification has expired. Re-request full identity verification.
FULL_ID_NEEDS_REVIEW: Required full identity needs review, including a provider-approved record whose full-identity evidence is incomplete. Provider approval alone is not sufficient. Seek human identity review.
SCOPE_NOT_FOUND: The requested job/contract/proposal participation scope could not be resolved. Scope-resolution error only; not emitted in this CandidateProjectEligibility read.
SCOPE_MISMATCH: The supplied scope identifiers do not resolve to the same job/participation context. Scope-resolution error only; not emitted in this CandidateProjectEligibility read.
SCOPE_USER_MISMATCH: The supplied person does not match the resolved participation scope. Scope-resolution error only; not emitted in this CandidateProjectEligibility read.
DECISION_MISSING: The participation has no current eligibility decision; this is not evidence of clearance.
DECISION_STALE: The decision is stale for the current policy/evidence or time window and needs reevaluation. Access-guard code only; not emitted in this CandidateProjectEligibility read. Use evaluatedAt as the freshness signal.

proposalId.description: The proposal (job offer) id the dossier is linked to.

evidence.description: Strict evidence mode (DEV-2923): omitted means concise (evidence null in the response); "full" adds the ten bounded metadata-only evidence families (cap 25 items each, truthful truncation, typed continuation). Exact lowercase values only.

asOf.description: Stable assembly timestamp shared by every provenance entry

candidate.description: Explicit allowlisted, masked candidate summary (first name + last-name initial only; no contact information)

hourlyRateStatus.description: DEV-3025 rate integrity: INVALID_RATE_DATA means the stored value fell outside the canonical 1..1000 USD / 2-decimal shape and hourlyRateUsd is null.

identityVerified.description: The Identity verified badge: verified and the profile name matches the name on the verified ID (OPE-44675).

links.description: Neutral candidate link metadata (DEV-2923 B2; resume pointer DEV-2977 B3.5). Legacy external resume references are REDACTED, never passed through. LinkedIn uses the one canonical profile normalizer. No email — work or personal — ever rides here.

resume.description: DEV-2977 B3.5 (F-D-2977-020): an EXACT three-state machine — the public contract cannot accept AVAILABLE with a null url or MISSING with a pointer. AVAILABLE carries the STABLE viewer-independent same-origin audited access path (/api/public/v1/proposals/{proposalId}/dossier/resume?mode=redirect) — never a signed storage URL — with a null dossier-level expiry (the stable pointer does not expire; the resume operation returns the signed-URL expiry). Byte-identical for every authorized dossier viewer; FOLLOWING it requires canonical-admin (OpenTrain staff) authority plus BOTH candidate_dossier:read AND candidate_documents:read — resume FILES are admin-only: employers and their agents receive a typed RESUME_FILES_ADMIN_ONLY 403, candidate self a typed SELF_ACCESS_NOT_SUPPORTED denial.

url.description: The stable relative same-origin audited access path for this proposal.

proposal.description: THIS authorized proposal — its own bid is intentionally included; evidence and cross-buyer sections never carry compensation.

amountStatus.description: DEV-3025: hourly bids outside 1..1000 USD / 2 decimals read null + INVALID_RATE_DATA; fixed-price and per-label amounts are never hourly-bounded.

score.description: Stored headline number — the interview+history composite when a score breakdown exists (byte-compatible with pre-existing consumers).

interviewOnlyScore.description: Interview-only sub-score (the number OpenTrain UIs show); equals the stored number for records without a breakdown.

location.description: Historical location snapshot captured at proposal submission (scope PROPOSAL_TIME_SNAPSHOT); never current access.

identity.description: The ONE shared candidate identity verdict (DEV-2922) returned identically by proposal detail, freelancer profile, and candidate dossier reads. `verified` is derived from `status` (never independently read); `source` names which policy branch answered; `conflict` carries status names only — never provider/session identifiers or document data.

current.description: True only for an unexpired VERIFIED verdict as of `asOf`.

nameMatchesProfile.description: OPE-44675: whether the profile name matches the name on the verified ID. False means the Identity verified badge is hidden for this name; null means the verdict is not current or the name was never checked.

identityAssurance.description: Privacy-safe decomposition of what the identity verdict established (DEV-2923), derived from the SAME canonical record selection as the verdict. The name match is only ever an enum — no names cross the wire. Legacy-only verdicts without a strict canonical assurance snapshot map every component to UNAVAILABLE with a null capture instant.

currentLocation.description: Dossier-only current-location decision detail (DEV-2923 B2): the SAME canonical eligibility decision the shared summary reflects, plus categorical decision facts. decisionId/decisionValidUntil are the decision’s own identity/bound, distinct from the participation-level validUntil. decisiveNetworkClassifications are the categorical classifications of exactly the decision-cited evidence — never coordinates, IP data, ASN, or timezone.

name: opentrain_get_candidate_dossier_resume_link
title: Get an Audited Candidate Resume Link
description: DEV-2977 B3.5 + DEV-3024 — audited candidate resume access, LINK-ONLY: returns the exact five-variant projection {url, expiresAt, availability, reason, provenanceStatus, provenance} with a fresh 600-second signed URL when AVAILABLE, or a truthful MISSING / LEGACY_EXTERNAL_REFERENCE_REDACTED / STORAGE_OBJECT_UNAVAILABLE state. AVAILABLE is split into provenance AVAILABLE or UNAVAILABLE; unavailable resume states carry provenance NOT_APPLICABLE. name: opentrain_admin_work_email_delivery_check
title: Check Managed Work-Email Delivery (Admin)
description: DEV-2975 — READ-ONLY ADMIN DIAGNOSTIC (admin_work_email.delivery_check): did a sender’s mail reach an exact managed @opentrain.work address in a bounded window? Use it before asking a client to resend an external-platform invitation (Slack, etc.). Requires an EXACT managed address, a sender filter (fromDomain and/or fromAddress), since (window ≤ 14 days, start ≤ 30 days ago) and a single-line reason. Needs the work_email_delivery:read permission (never part of Full access); the server additionally requires an OpenTrain platform admin in the OpenTrain admin organization — everyone else gets 403. Delivery metadata only (sender domain, subject, received time, Inbox/Junk folder, provider ids) — never bodies, previews, attachments, display names or other recipients. Only received mail naming the exact address in To/Cc counts (drafts and sent copies never do). Verdicts: DELIVERED, DELIVERED_TO_JUNK, NOT_FOUND (every candidate scanned and not in the mailbox — the SMTP log is not read, so never proof the sender was refused), INCONCLUSIVE (no match before the 500-candidate scan cap; see coverage), MAILBOX_UNAVAILABLE, MAILBOX_NOT_FOUND; a provider outage is a retryable 503 PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE. Every check is audited with its reason before the result returns. structuredContent IS the raw closed response; failure text never echoes server error text.

name: opentrain_people_agent_notes
title: Agent Notes for One Person on One Job
description: Read or explicitly update ONE person’s job-scoped Agent notes — the Markdown document where you keep durable, job-relevant learnings and feedback about this person across proposals, messages, interviews, assessments, contracts, Project To-dos and training (people_table.agent_notes.*). The document is scoped to organization + job + jobPersonId: the same person on another job or in another organization has another, isolated document; it is never a global profile and never appears in talent search, profiles, the candidate dossier or worker surfaces. Behaviour contract: READ the notes before substantive work with this person; UPDATE them after a material, durable learning or feedback event — not after every message; keep facts, observations, feedback, open questions and follow-ups distinguishable; attach bounded sourceReferences (proposal, conversation, message, interview, assessment, contract, project_todo, training, or manual) that belong to this person on this job; refer to the person by the masked display name or ids only; NEVER store contact details, credentials, government ids, payment data, medical data, protected-class inference, personal speculation or raw message dumps; correct superseded facts instead of accumulating contradictions. action=get returns the full document with version/etag and the contract; action=append adds appendMarkdown after the body at expectedVersion (0 creates); action=replace rewrites bodyMarkdown at expectedVersion; action=archive (confirm=true) clears the body, keeps every revision, and is the only destructive lifecycle — there is no delete; action=history pages revision metadata (includeContent needs people_table:write). Writes need idempotencyKey (8-128 chars; same key + same payload replays, changed payload is a 409) and refuse, with value-free diagnostics, a stale expectedVersion (409 VERSION_MISMATCH with the current version), oversized or empty bodies, raw HTML (UNSAFE_MARKDOWN), the person’s full name, surname, e-mail or phone in the body or reason (CONTENT_LEAK: one generic refusal with no line, kind or field, audited hash-only) and foreign source references. Each write that passes every other check spends one attempt of the account’s write budget (10 writes per hour across all jobs, shared by the web and API surfaces; an exact replay or an earlier refusal spends nothing); once it is spent, every write is a 429 RATE_LIMITED until the window moves. Requires people_table:read (get, history) or people_table:write (append, replace, archive, history content).

name: opentrain_people_table_describe
title: Describe a Job People Table
description: Describe a job’s People table for this key (people_table.describe): every column with its exposure, capabilities and filter operators, the limits, the saved views (no config) and the stage counts over eligible people. Call it before opentrain_people_table_query. Columns are addressed by id (country, custom:<fieldId>). Contact, financial and compliance columns are redacted for API keys and read exactly like unknown columns (COLUMN_NOT_QUERYABLE); Project To-do columns also need project_todos:read and Screening lms:read; candidate-written text (profile title, city, skills and other tag lists) is scrubbed of contact data and the surname and is selectable only. Names are the public "First L." (else "Unnamed candidate") and selectable only: no search, filter, sort or facet runs on a name, and a query with no sort returns a stable order that is not by name. Address a person by jobPersonId. Banned, closed and non-visible candidates never appear in rows, counts or facets. Reads spend the key’s budget (120 requests a minute and 50,000 rows an hour across jobs and surfaces), and a key runs at most 2 People table reads at a time (limits.readsInFlightPerKey); a spent budget, a third read in flight or a busy server is a 429 RATE_LIMITED with a retry delay. A read over its database bound (10 s a statement, limits.readStatementTimeoutMs; 15 s in all) is a 503 READ_TIMEOUT: narrow the request (a filter, fewer facets, no total) or retry after the delay. Requires people_table:read.

name: opentrain_people_table_changes
title: List Job People Table Changes
description: List a job’s People table changes, oldest first (people_table.changes.list): custom cells (by jobPersonId), columns, views, your own preferences, the job default and Agent-notes metadata (never a note body or preview). Only settled changes are listed (settledThrough); a slower write arrives on a later call. Pass since on the first call; every call returns page.nextCursor, which you keep and pass back as cursor to read what changed next. A PERSON value naming a person you cannot see reads null; changes about such a person, and another member’s PERSONAL views and preferences, are not listed. Built-in columns have no events: query rows again. A cursor older than 30 days is CHANGES_CURSOR_EXPIRED. Columns are addressed by id (country, custom:<fieldId>). Contact, financial and compliance columns are redacted for API keys and read exactly like unknown columns (COLUMN_NOT_QUERYABLE); Project To-do columns also need project_todos:read and Screening lms:read; candidate-written text (profile title, city, skills and other tag lists) is scrubbed of contact data and the surname and is selectable only. Names are the public "First L." (else "Unnamed candidate") and selectable only: no search, filter, sort or facet runs on a name, and a query with no sort returns a stable order that is not by name. Address a person by jobPersonId. Banned, closed and non-visible candidates never appear in rows, counts or facets. Reads spend the key’s budget (120 requests a minute and 50,000 rows an hour across jobs and surfaces), and a key runs at most 2 People table reads at a time (limits.readsInFlightPerKey); a spent budget, a third read in flight or a busy server is a 429 RATE_LIMITED with a retry delay. A read over its database bound (10 s a statement, limits.readStatementTimeoutMs; 15 s in all) is a 503 READ_TIMEOUT: narrow the request (a filter, fewer facets, no total) or retry after the delay. Requires people_table:read.

name: opentrain_people_table_query

A malformed rule is INVALID_FILTER either way. Columns are addressed by id (country, custom:<fieldId>). Contact, financial and compliance columns are redacted for API keys and read exactly like unknown columns (COLUMN_NOT_QUERYABLE); Project To-do columns also need project_todos:read and Screening lms:read; candidate-written text (profile title, city, skills and other tag lists) is scrubbed of contact data and the surname and is selectable only. Names are the public "First L." (else "Unnamed candidate") and selectable only: no search, filter, sort or facet runs on a name, and a query with no sort returns a stable order that is not by name. Address a person by jobPersonId. Banned, closed and non-visible candidates never appear in rows, counts or facets. Reads spend the key’s budget (120 requests a minute and 50,000 rows an hour across jobs and surfaces), and a key runs at most 2 People table reads at a time (limits.readsInFlightPerKey); a spent budget, a third read in flight or a busy server is a 429 RATE_LIMITED with a retry delay. A read over its database bound (10 s a statement, limits.readStatementTimeoutMs; 15 s in all) is a 503 READ_TIMEOUT: narrow the request (a filter, fewer facets, no total) or retry after the delay. Requires people_table:read.

name: opentrain_people_table_columns
title: Manage Job People Table Columns
description: Manage a job’s People table columns: action=list returns every column for this key with its exposure, capabilities and version (people_table.columns.list); action=create adds a custom column of any of the 15 types (people_table.columns.create), up to 100 active custom columns per job (limits.customColumnsMaxPerJob; archived ones do not count; one more is LIMIT_EXCEEDED); action=update renames one (people_table.columns.update); action=archive previews the impact with dryRun=true and archives with confirm=true (people_table.columns.archive). Only custom columns are editable (custom:<fieldId>); built-in and system columns answer COLUMN_NOT_EDITABLE. Writes go through the web’s own column and cell rules, at expectedVersion (a stale version is VERSION_MISMATCH), and every audit event records an agent actor and the request’s batchId. Writes spend the key’s write budget (60 requests a minute and 10,000 edits an hour across jobs and surfaces; a dryRun counts as a read). Requires people_table:write, except columns action=list (people_table:read).

settings.description: CURRENCY: currencyCode, precision, minimum, maximum; NUMBER and PERCENT: precision, minimum, maximum; DURATION: durationUnit. Other keys for the type are refused.

name: opentrain_people_table_cells
title: Write Job People Table Cells
description: Write a job’s People table custom cells: action=batch writes 1-500 cells at expectedVersion (people_table.cells.batch), atomic by default (all or nothing) or mode=independent (each edit commits on its own; retrying with the same idempotencyKey finishes only the edits that had not committed), with one result per edit; dryRun=true checks every edit and writes nothing. A request body over 4 MiB of UTF-8 (limits.writeBodyMaxBytes) is LIMIT_EXCEEDED: split a large batch. Hosted /mcp stops waiting after 180 s, sooner than REST (300 s): for a large batch use mode=independent with an idempotencyKey, and if the call times out retry the same key to finish it. action=set writes or clears (value null) one cell (people_table.cells.set). Address rows by jobPersonId; a row this key cannot reach is a 404. A PERSON value is a jobPersonId on the same job. Only custom columns are editable (custom:<fieldId>); built-in and system columns answer COLUMN_NOT_EDITABLE. Writes go through the web’s own column and cell rules, at expectedVersion (a stale version is VERSION_MISMATCH), and every audit event records an agent actor and the request’s batchId. Writes spend the key’s write budget (60 requests a minute and 10,000 edits an hour across jobs and surfaces; a dryRun counts as a read). Requires people_table:write, except columns action=list (people_table:read).

name: opentrain_people_table_views
title: Manage Job People Table Views
description: Manage a job’s People table views: action=list returns built-in, ORGANIZATION and your own PERSONAL views with configs and your defaults (people_table.views.list); action=get one view (people_table.views.get); create, update (at expectedVersion), archive and restore a PERSONAL or ORGANIZATION view (people_table.views.*); set_personal_default sets your own default or last opened view (people_table.preferences.set); set_job_default sets the job default, organization owners only and ORGANIZATION views only (people_table.job_default_view.set). Configs address columns by id. A saved filter rule on a column this key cannot query, or on person, reads withheld: true with no value; update keeps it when you send it back as read, or removes it by id in removeWithheldRuleIds, and refuses one you do neither with (VIEW_NOT_APPLICABLE). Another member’s PERSONAL view is a 404. Writes need idempotencyKey and spend the write budget. Requires people_table:write, except list and get (people_table:read).

name: opentrain_search_talent
title: Search Vetted Talent
description: Employer-only `talent:read` — DEV-3084 search the vetted talent pool (talent.search). Worker principals are refused at mint and at use, including legacy tokens. With q, hybrid semantic + lexical ranking; without q, facet browse by reputation. country accepts a name, alpha-2, or alpha-3 (USA/US, Canada/CA, United Kingdom/GB/GBR, Australia/AU all normalize). sort=recent is a DETERMINISTIC full-discoverable-pool census ordered memberSince DESC, id ASC (independent of vector relevance): page it with cursor from nextCursor — cursor requires sort=recent and excludes offset. minHourlyRate/maxHourlyRate bound USD rates; memberSinceFrom/memberSinceTo are inclusive ISO bounds. Responses carry truthful nextCursor/complete/total, and every card is privacy-safe (masked name, response-time [REDACTED_*] contact sanitization with redactions provenance).

nextCursor.description: Opaque continuation for deterministic sort=recent enumeration.

complete.description: True only when the current pagination sequence has no later page.

name: opentrain_disposition_proposal
title: Disposition an Employer Proposal (Decline / Maybe / Restore)
description: DEV-2986 — employer-only proposal disposition (proposal_management.proposals.disposition; the family is DEFAULT-OFF via AGENT_SURFACE_PROPOSAL_MANAGEMENT_ENABLED). DECLINE → DECLINED, MAYBE → MAYBE, RESTORE returns a DECLINED proposal to its last safe audited prior status (UNREVIEWED/SHORTLISTED/MAYBE, else UNREVIEWED). CAS-pinned by expectedStatus (typed 409 STALE_PROPOSAL_STATUS on a lost race); HIRED, provider-managed RESUME_SENT, and active-contract proposals fail closed as typed 409s. Same idempotencyKey + payload replays the exact original outcome; the key also rides the Idempotency-Key header. Every applied transition appends one immutable audit event; candidate self-access is never authority. Requires proposals:write.

replayed.description: True when a same-key retry replayed the original stored outcome.

name: opentrain_list_proposal_disposition_history
title: List Proposal Disposition Audit History
description: DEV-2986 — OWNER-ONLY newest-first page of the append-only proposal disposition audit ledger (proposal_management.proposals.disposition_history.list; DEFAULT-OFF family). Employer reasons/notes never reach candidates. Bounded: limit ≤ 100 with an opaque cursor continuation. Requires proposals:read.

name: opentrain_get_proposal_interview_recording
title: Get the Full AI Voice-Interview Recording for a Proposal
description: DEV-4498 — the WHOLE audio recording of a proposal's AI voice interview (interviewer and candidate, start to finish) as short-lived signed URL(s) plus metadata (proposals.interview.recording; GET /proposals/{proposalId}/interview/recording). Use it when a human needs to HEAR the candidate — for example to check spoken English fluency or accent, which a transcript cannot show. Same access as the transcript: proposals:read plus ownership of the proposal's job; foreign or unknown proposals are an opaque 404. Released only when the candidate consented to recording, and every admitted attempt is audited server-side before any URL is disclosed. MCP cannot hand a binary to the human: open or download `recording.url` (and every `recording.segments[].url` when `delivery` is SEGMENTS) with your own HTTP client BEFORE `recording.expiresAt` (at most 10 minutes), or run `opentrain proposals interview-audio --proposal-id <id>` to save a file. A normal interview is ONE file (`delivery: SINGLE_FILE`); several segments appear only when the browser recorder restarted mid-interview, and `concatenation` says whether they can be byte-joined (MP3/Ogg) or must stay separate numbered files (WebM/MP4 — no server-side remux). Typed denials via details.reason: NO_AUDIO_TEXT_MODALITY (text interview, 404), RECORDING_CONSENT_REQUIRED (403), RECORDING_PROCESSING (409, retry later), RECORDING_NOT_AVAILABLE (404), RECORDING_REMOVED (404, permanently removed), RECORDING_MANIFEST_UNAVAILABLE (503, retryable: the segment manifest could not be read; nothing partial is ever served as the whole interview), RECORDING_SIGNING_FAILED (503, retryable), SELF_ACCESS_NOT_SUPPORTED (403, candidate self). Failures carry only the status, code, reason and request id — never the upstream message. Check `audio` on the proposal interview transcript first to know whether audio exists. Never returns storage paths or durable URLs. The response is validated against the closed advertised schema before success.

mimeType.description: MIME type of the first segment: audio/webm (Chrome, Firefox, Edge) or audio/mp4 (Safari) as recorded by the browser.

fileExtension.description: Suggested extension for a download (webm, m4a, mp3, ...).

url.description: The whole recording when delivery is SINGLE_FILE; otherwise the first segment.

concatenation.description: What a client must do with several segments. WebM and MP4 files cannot be byte-joined (each carries a file header) and there is no server-side remux, so multi-segment recordings in those containers are SEPARATE_FILES.

url.description: Short-lived signed URL (at most 10 minutes). Accepted exception: the URL itself embeds the provider object key (opaque ids only); no storage identifier appears elsewhere.

name: opentrain_get_job_time_reconciliation
title: Get Job Provider Time Reconciliation
description: DEV-3174 — employer-side provider (Hubstaff) time reconciliation for one job (time_tracking.reconciliation.get): per-worker enrollment state, tracked/manual/billable totals, daily rollups, latest approval, and source sync freshness. pageTotals cover the returned cursor page only, so summing every page is safe. Optional contractId drill-down (must belong to the job) and contractStatus ACTIVE|ENDED cohort filter using the canonical definition (ENDED = closed OR endDate <= now, evaluated once per request). Requires time:read plus provider-authorized job access (job owner or a provider-access-authorized organization member); other members and unknown jobs read as non-enumerating 404s. Never returns screenshots, window titles, memos, or raw provider payloads.

includeLms.description: DEV-4494: add the read-only per-worker LMS course projection (assigned job courses, status/progress, latest lesson activity, provider time during vs outside course spans) as lms on each worker plus a job-level lms block. Same scopes, ownership checks and paging; omitted (not zeroed) when the job has no LMS courses.

lms.description: Present only with includeLms on a job that has LMS courses. A worker with no course assignment carries an empty courses list.

percentComplete.description: Whole-number percent of in-scope lessons completed; null with no lessons.

span.description: Course span used for the time split: first lesson start (or first view) until completion. endsAt is null while the course is open; the whole object is null when the worker never opened the course.

trackedSecondsDuringCourses.description: Provider tracked seconds in this page’s range overlapping any course span.

trackedSecondsOutsideCourses.description: totals.trackedSeconds minus the seconds during courses.

lms.description: Present only with includeLms on a job that has LMS courses (active course links or course assignments). Omitted, never zeroed, otherwise.

courses.description: Active job courses (course links), in link order.

note.description: Honest derivation note for the time split. When a per-page read bound was hit (50 job courses, the 500 most recent course assignments, 50 course versions), it says so; request a smaller page for complete per-worker course data.

name: opentrain_list_job_time_sessions
title: List Job Provider Time Sessions
description: DEV-3174 — bounded session-level provider (Hubstaff) evidence for one employer job (time_tracking.sessions.list): masked worker identity, start/stop/duration, input activity, provider project/task, manual/billable/paid/locked state, approval period, stable source IDs, and sync freshness. Optional UTC-date range, contract, status, and cursor/limit filters. Requires time:read plus provider-authorized job access; other members and unknown jobs read as non-enumerating 404s. Memo is an honest null because the provider does not capture it. Never returns screenshots, window titles, or raw provider payloads.

memo.description: Honest null: Hubstaff activity imports do not provide a session memo.

name: opentrain_create_admin_balance_hire
title: Create an Admin-Balance Hire
description: Hire an OpenTrain proposal with ADMIN_BALANCE funding: creates the contract plus the ACTIVE_FUNDED initial milestone with internal-balance funding metadata. Zero money moves and no approval record is created; the later milestone approval/release that moves money stays human-only in the web app. Internal, default-off surface for verified OpenTrain admins in the canonical admin organization — the admin_balance_hire:create scope alone never grants access (the server independently verifies platform-admin status, the Admin Pay allowlist, canonical-org membership, and the proposal organization; everything fails closed). Request-bound idempotency: same idempotencyKey + payload converges; key reuse with a changed payload conflicts; concurrency cannot duplicate the contract. The response carries a live `onboarding` receipt for the new hire’s auto-assigned Project To-dos (exact assignment readback, durable hook state, provider provisioning state; recomputed on every replay): `onboarding.status` COMPLETE is the only full success — PENDING, RETRYABLE_FAILED, or terminal FAILED is a PARTIAL SUCCESS: for PENDING/RETRYABLE_FAILED retry this tool with the SAME idempotencyKey to re-heal and re-check; for FAILED (error.retryable=false) follow error.remediation instead (a same-key retry cannot heal it); read opentrain_list_project_todos for the contract when you need current assignment truth. DEV-4500: the contract rate defaults to the applicant’s bid unless you pass rateUsd; the contract is always created at the bid and a different rateUsd is proposed to the worker through the compensation-change flow (rate.status PENDING_WORKER_ACCEPTANCE) — a rate different from the bid needs the worker’s acceptance and is never written silently. Pass hours (hourly proposals) to fund hours × the bid with the hours recorded on the milestone; with both amountUsd and hours a mismatch is rejected. The response always echoes rate (contractRateUsd, bidRateUsd, postedRateUsd, requestedRateUsd, status) and warnings, e.g. when the bid differs from the job’s posted rate.

proposalId.description: The proposal (job offer) id to hire with ADMIN_BALANCE funding.

idempotencyKey.description: Request-bound idempotency key. Same key + payload converges; key reuse with a changed payload conflicts.

amountUsd.description: Milestone amount in USD. Optional when hours is given (then hours × the bid).

hours.description: DEV-4500: funded hours (hourly proposals only). The milestone amount is hours × the contract rate (the bid) and the hours are recorded on the milestone.

rateUsd.description: DEV-4500: requested contract rate (USD/hour). Defaults to the applicant’s bid; a different rate is proposed to the worker (PENDING acceptance), never written silently.

volume.description: DEV-4500: funded hours when the hire recorded them.

contractRateUsd.description: The rate the contract is created at: always the applicant’s bid.

postedRateUsd.description: The job’s posted hourly rate (null for non-hourly jobs).

status.description: PENDING_WORKER_ACCEPTANCE: the requested rate is proposed and still pending. PROPOSAL_RESOLVED: it was proposed and the worker (or a later proposal) already resolved it — see compensationChangeStatus. PROPOSAL_FAILED: the hire completed at the bid and the rate proposal is confirmed NOT recorded (or, with failureCode RATE_PROPOSAL_KEY_REUSED, this key is bound to a change at a different rate). PROPOSAL_UNKNOWN: the hire completed, the proposal threw and its outcome could not be confirmed. `contracts propose-rate` converges on an existing pending proposal for the same rate, so retrying is safe.

compensationChangeStatus.description: The compensation change’s lifecycle as read back after the hire; null when nothing was proposed or the readback failed.

failureCode.description: Bounded code set exactly when status is PROPOSAL_FAILED or PROPOSAL_UNKNOWN; never raw error text.

warnings.description: DEV-4500: e.g. the contract rate (the bid) differs from the job’s posted rate, or the requested rate is pending the worker’s acceptance.

onboarding.description: Live new-hire onboarding truth for the contract, recomputed from exact database readback on every response. `status` COMPLETE is the only fully-successful state (every auto-assigned Project To-do exists by exact readback AND the durable onboarding hook settled successfully). PENDING means the durable hook is still queued/running/deferred and has never failed; RETRYABLE_FAILED means an attempt failed or an invariant is unmet and `error.retryable` is true — retry the SAME idempotency key to re-heal and re-check; FAILED is terminal (`error.retryable` false — follow `error.remediation`). Read `GET /project-todos?contractId=` for current assignment truth.

status.description: RETRYABLE_FAILED ⇔ error.retryable is true (retry the same idempotency key); FAILED is terminal (error.retryable false — follow error.remediation).

notifications.description: Durable outbox state only — never a delivery claim.

name: opentrain_propose_contract_rate
title: Propose a Contract Hourly Rate
description: DEV-4500 — propose a new hourly rate for an active OpenTrain contract (payments.contracts.propose_rate, POST /contracts/{contractId}/compensation). Goes through the SAME worker-consent flow as the web app: records a PENDING compensation change with the existing audit trail, notifies the worker, and the worker accepts or appeals. The contract rate never changes here — only on the worker’s acceptance; existing milestones stay at the current rate. The contract rate at hire defaults to the applicant’s bid unless you pass rateUsd on the hire; a rate different from the bid needs the worker’s acceptance and is never written silently. Requires payments:write plus employer access to the contract (owner or job access; denials are non-enumerating 404s). Hourly (PAY_PER_HOUR) contracts only. idempotencyKey (8-128 chars) is required and makes retries converge.

idempotencyKey.description: Request-bound idempotency key; same key + payload converges.

rateUsd.description: Proposed rate in USD per hour (1–1000, at most 2 decimals).

reason.description: Optional note the worker sees with the proposal.

status.description: PENDING right after the proposal; a same-key retry that resumed a committed proposal reports its CURRENT state.

converged.description: True when the same rate was already pending (or its proposal had committed before a later step failed, or a same-key retry resumed the change it committed) and the existing change was returned without creating or re-sending anything.

name: opentrain_create_admin_balance_milestone
title: Create an Admin-Balance Milestone
description: Add a later ADMIN_BALANCE-funded milestone to a canonical-admin-org OpenTrain contract: the milestone ends ACTIVE_FUNDED with internal-balance funding metadata. Zero money moves and no approval record is created; the milestone approval/release that moves money stays human-only in the web app. Same fail-closed authorization as opentrain_create_admin_balance_hire (default-off surface; the scope alone never grants access). Domain sequencing applies: an earlier unreleased milestone conflicts until a human approves/releases it. Request-bound idempotency: same idempotencyKey + payload converges on the same milestone; key reuse with a changed payload conflicts.

contractId.description: The contract id to add the ADMIN_BALANCE-funded milestone to.

idempotencyKey.description: Request-bound idempotency key. Same key + payload converges; key reuse with a changed payload conflicts.

volume.description: Positive hours/labels for hourly or per-label contracts. Omit to derive from amountUsd and the canonical contract rate.

name: opentrain_fund_admin_balance_milestone
title: Fund an Existing Milestone with Admin Balance
description: Apply ADMIN_BALANCE to one existing NOT_FUNDED milestone without creating a duplicate. Zero money moves and no Stripe charge or PaymentIntent is created; payout/release remains human-only. Requires the same fail-closed canonical-admin organization, platform-admin, Admin Pay allowlist, token-organization, scope, and rollout checks as creation. Contract/milestone linkage, compensation, status, and sequencing are verified. Request-bound idempotency makes retries converge.

idempotencyKey.description: Request-bound idempotency key; reuse it for safe retries.

name: opentrain_cancel_admin_balance_milestone
title: Cancel a Funded Milestone
description: Cancel one internally funded milestone through the restricted canonical-admin surface. Existing ownership, payout, refund, contract-state and idempotency guards remain active. The operation fails closed. Zero money moves: the agent surface is limited to ADMIN_BALANCE funding and returns NO_MONEY_MOVED; card/credit funding is refused with HUMAN_APPROVAL_REQUIRED and remains on the human-only path. Notifications are suppressed by default for administrative cleanup and require explicit notifyCounterparty: true.

name: opentrain_create_admin_balance_rehire
title: Rehire from an Ended Contract with Admin Balance
description: Rehire one worker from an ended contract as a NEW ADMIN_BALANCE-funded contract with an ACTIVE_FUNDED qualification milestone. Preserves the ended contract and historical proposal. Zero money moves during rehire; later release remains human-only. Reuses the canonical Job Messages conversation and converges current new-hire Project To-dos/integrations. Fails closed on active contracts, stale lineage, open money or a dispute on any contract of the job + worker (funded or unreleased milestones, milestones under review or with unresolved refunds, unsettled payouts, pending approvals, disputed time, timesheets awaiting review), an ended contract whose tracker enrollment is neither revoked nor carried (PROVIDER_OFFBOARDING_PENDING: a live, error-free membership on the path contract is carried instead; a pending, errored or uncarried one blocks; retry after the old offboarding confirms the revocation), cross-tenant targets, or missing canonical-admin authority. Request-bound and generation-scoped idempotency, the same as the REST operation, prevents duplicate contracts. The `carryOver` report in the response lists every item the NEW contract carried (still-valid identity checks, agreements signed on unchanged content, to-dos completed on the same version, training courses completed on the same course version under the same modules and completion policy with their completed lessons but never attempts or answers, a live tracker membership on the same project with zero provider calls, the Job DM), reset with a reason, skipped or blocked, plus `humanActions` a person still needs to take; it is fixed when the rehire commits. Besides the legacy `provisioning` fields, the response carries a live `onboarding` receipt for the NEW contract (exact assignment readback, durable hook state, provider provisioning state; recomputed on every replay): `onboarding.status` COMPLETE is the only full success — PENDING, RETRYABLE_FAILED, or terminal FAILED is a PARTIAL SUCCESS: for PENDING/RETRYABLE_FAILED retry this tool with the SAME idempotencyKey to re-heal and re-check; for FAILED (error.retryable=false) follow error.remediation instead (a same-key retry cannot heal it); read opentrain_list_project_todos for the new contract when you need current assignment truth.

priorContractId.description: The ended contract id to chain the new contract from.

idempotencyKey.description: Request-bound idempotency key.

volume.description: DEV-4500: funded hours when the hire recorded them.

provisioning.description: Legacy by-construction provisioning fields (projectTodos.queued, integrations, eligibility). Live onboarding truth is `onboarding`.

onboarding.description: Live new-hire onboarding truth for the contract, recomputed from exact database readback on every response. `status` COMPLETE is the only fully-successful state (every auto-assigned Project To-do exists by exact readback AND the durable onboarding hook settled successfully). PENDING means the durable hook is still queued/running/deferred and has never failed; RETRYABLE_FAILED means an attempt failed or an invariant is unmet and `error.retryable` is true — retry the SAME idempotency key to re-heal and re-check; FAILED is terminal (`error.retryable` false — follow `error.remediation`). Read `GET /project-todos?contractId=` for current assignment truth.

status.description: RETRYABLE_FAILED ⇔ error.retryable is true (retry the same idempotency key); FAILED is terminal (error.retryable false — follow error.remediation).

notifications.description: Durable outbox state only — never a delivery claim.

policy.description: A rehire always creates a new contract; the ended one is never reopened.

disposition.description: CARRIED: reused on the new contract. RESET: the new contract starts it fresh (see reason). SKIPPED: nothing to carry. BLOCKED: not carried; a person must look.

name: opentrain_preflight_contract_offboarding
title: Plan a Contract Offboarding (Zero-Write)
description: Strictly no-write offboarding plan for one contract: inventories pending money for settlement/final-close planning (never as access-offboarding blockers), open Project To-dos, LMS training assignments, the EXACT canonical adapter-confirmable provider revocation targets (shared discovery with execution), every manual-first shared annotation account, channel memberships to soft-remove, and the preserved Job Message history, then returns a signed expected-state planToken pinned to the COMPLETE reviewed teardown projection for opentrain_confirm_contract_offboarding. Persists nothing. Read-authorized: payments:read suffices (payments:write implies read); only the confirm demands payments:write. Owner-only (DEV-3173): requires the employer organization OWNER — assigned or provider-authorized members with contract access get a typed 403 ORGANIZATION_OWNER_REQUIRED (a bounded error, never an OAuth prompt) — plus the default-off contract-offboarding surface.

contractId.description: Contract id to plan offboarding for.

name: opentrain_confirm_contract_offboarding
title: Execute a Planned Contract Offboarding
description: Execute the reviewed contract offboarding. Requires a reason, idempotency key, signed planToken, and explicit confirm: true. Owner-only (DEV-3173): requires the employer organization OWNER; other members receive ORGANIZATION_OWNER_REQUIRED and organization-scoped tokens for another organization receive ORGANIZATION_SCOPE_MISMATCH. Access is revoked first by moving participation to OFFBOARDING; unsettled milestones remain payable and never delay access revocation. Provider, Project To-do, LMS, annotation, and messaging cleanup is durable and retryable. Successful cleanup moves the same contract identity to OFFBOARDED_PAYABLE (lifecycleStatus CLOSING). When the preflight fields automaticClose.enabled and automaticClose.eligible are both true, the contract ends by itself, once, after its last open payment settles through the existing human-approved paths, and no payment can be added after it ends; otherwise the owner ends it with opentrain_close_contract after settlement. A stale review flag on a completed, transferred milestone is cleared with opentrain_clear_contract_milestone_review_flag. Manual annotation cleanup is reported truthfully without claiming provider-side completion. Never sends chat, never touches proposals, and moves no money.

idempotencyKey.description: Request-bound idempotency key; reuse it to converge on the same result.

planToken.description: Signed expected-state token from the reviewed preflight.

confirm.description: Explicit acknowledgement that this live offboarding is intentional.

Read the independent participation, settlement, and cleanup states for one contract, including provider/manual cleanup steps and errors.

name: opentrain_get_contract_history
title: Read Canonical Engagement History
description: Demo and sample rows (tour fixtures, the docs-demo seed, DEMO_* accounts, Bubble-era onboarding Sample Job engagements) are always excluded (DEV-2924). Read one engagement's canonical history — proposal → contract(s) → milestones/payouts — for EXACTLY one contractId or proposalId (DEV-2830, contract_lifecycle.history.get). Employer-side only: unknown, foreign, candidate-self, and worker-self selectors are one opaque 404 (details carry only the resource); only a missing payments:read is a 403. current.access derives ONLY from participationState ACTIVE/REACTIVATED (ACTIVE | NONE | CONFLICT with every such contract listed — nothing is picked silently; the proposal's HIRED label is never access). view=current returns every active record (all under CONFLICT) else the latest ended record; view=timeline returns every bounded lineage record plus a chronology of durable stored timestamps only (the proposal's current status is observed, never placed in the chronology). Rehire links come ONLY from admin_balance.rehire_created audit rows; purpose comes ONLY from work-project evidence (a capped or partial evidence set stays UNSPECIFIED). Bounded — 50 contracts, 200 milestones per contract, 500 timeline entries, 50 evidence rows per contract — with explicit truncated flags; no cursor. structuredContent is the raw closed response.

name: opentrain_close_contract
title: Finally Close an Offboarded Contract
description: Owner-only. Finally close an OFFBOARDED_PAYABLE contract. Fails until all earned-payment blockers and payout deliveries are settled. Needed when the automatic close does not apply (preflight automaticClose not enabled or not eligible); an eligible contract can already have ended by itself, and a repeat close of a CLOSED contract is idempotent. Requires explicit confirm: true and does not re-run offboarding.

name: opentrain_reactivate_contract
title: Reactivate Contract Participation
description: Owner-only. Restore project participation on the same contract identity without creating a replacement financial contract. Requires explicit confirm: true.

name: opentrain_clear_contract_milestone_review_flag
title: Clear a Stale Milestone Review Flag
description: Owner-only (DEV-3066). Clear a stale review flag on one completed milestone whose payout is recorded, transferred and provider-verified. Only the flag changes; no money moves and an audit record is kept. Refuses pending approvals, open refunds and OpenTrain-owned funding reviews. When the automatic close is enabled and the contract is eligible, a closing contract then closes by itself if nothing else is open (result contractAutoClose). Requires explicit confirm: true.

name: opentrain_list_managed_messaging_channels
title: List Managed Messaging Channels
description: List existing job channels without query-time creation. Requires messages:read, a claimed account, the default-off messaging-management surface, and job access. If YOU observe repeated worker confusion while reading messages, that is your own inference — not a platform-detected fact. Record it as an observation with authority INFERRED, then propose the existing zero-write retraining workflow: create a DRAFT retraining case, preview its plan, request explicit human approval, and only then assign. Never auto-create or auto-assign retraining from message content.

name: opentrain_send_message
title: Send a Message
description: Send a generic plain-text message into an existing OpenTrain conversation. This tool is intentionally outside shared Job Operations synchronization. When managing a job, do NOT use this tool: claim the shared action, re-read root and thread messages, and use opentrain_send_managed_job_message instead. name: opentrain_edit_message
title: Edit a Sent Message
description: Edit a message YOU sent (author-only; other senders read as not found). Use this to correct an already-sent instruction or accidentally shared credential: the stored body is replaced and the prior version is preserved in an append-only server-side revision ledger. Optimistic concurrency is required: pass expectedRevision equal to the message readback `revision` field (0 for never-edited messages); a stale value returns 409 REVISION_CONFLICT with currentRevision — re-read and retry. Content is accepted when non-empty and at most 10,000 characters after trimming and is transmitted exactly as supplied. Requires an Idempotency-Key of 1-128 chars from [A-Za-z0-9._:-] (minimum one) and messages:write.

messageId.description: Id of a message the token owner sent.

content.description: Replacement body. Must be non-empty and at most 10,000 characters AFTER trimming; the supplied string is forwarded unchanged (no client-side trimming or newline normalization).

expectedRevision.description: The message readback `revision` value this edit is based on (0..2147483646). A stale value is a 409 REVISION_CONFLICT carrying currentRevision.

idempotencyKey.description: Required stable retry key (1-128 chars of [A-Za-z0-9._:-]; minimum ONE). Same key replays the committed result; it travels only as the Idempotency-Key header.

name: opentrain_delete_message
title: Delete a Sent Message
description: Delete a message YOU sent (author-only; other senders read as not found). This is a NON-destructive tombstone: the row is never removed — content, attachments, and audio read blanked and the prior values survive only in the append-only server-side revision ledger. Optimistic concurrency is required: pass expectedRevision equal to the message readback `revision` field; a stale value returns 409 REVISION_CONFLICT with currentRevision. Requires an Idempotency-Key of 1-128 chars from [A-Za-z0-9._:-] (minimum one) and messages:write.

Whole-thread latestWorkerReply/latestEmployerReply and ORGANIZATION-level needsEmployerReply are response evidence, NOT issue resolution. name: opentrain_get_message_attachment
title: Get Message Attachment
description: Retrieve one message attachment through the authenticated, audited OpenTrain attachment read (messages.attachments.get; requires messages:read). Pass the opaque attachmentId (att_ + 32 hex) from opentrain_audit_job_messages or opentrain_get_message_thread (attachments[].attachmentId). A verified PNG/JPEG/WebP/GIF at or below 4 MiB is returned as an image content block you can look at directly (exact sniffed MIME type + base64 of the verified bytes). Anything else — any non-image, or any image above 4 MiB — is returned as a resource_link to opentrain://messages/{messageId}/attachments/{attachmentId}; read that resource for the verified bytes (≤ 20 MiB, audited). structuredContent carries verified metadata only (name, sniffed mimeType, byteSize, sha256, source, delivery, resourceUri, requestId) — never bytes, never a signed URL, storage path, or legacy URL. Missing, foreign, and unknown selectors are ONE opaque 404; deleted/hidden/unavailable attachments are a 409 with a closed reason; 429 carries retry metadata; 503 is retryable.

messageId.description: Id of a message in a conversation the token can read.

attachmentId.description: Opaque attachment id (att_ + 32 hex) from a message read, audit, or thread read (attachments[].attachmentId).

delivery.description: inline = image content block; resource = resource_link to the canonical URI.

name: opentrain_manage_messaging
title: Manage OpenTrain Messaging
description: Apply an idempotent non-destructive messaging mutation: channel create/rename/update/archive/unarchive, member add/remove/leave, ownership transfer, thread reply, desired-state reaction/pins, or soft moderation. channels.update takes {conversationId, name?, autoAddNewHires?} (at least one setting). channels.archive / channels.unarchive take {conversationId}; an archived channel stays readable but accepts no messages and adds no new hires, and archiving the job's default team chat (jobDefaultChannel) also stops a new one being created. members.add takes {conversationId, userId} or {conversationId, userIds: [...]} (up to 100, all or nothing). No hard delete, bans/reports, mute, or DM conversion.

name: opentrain_list_project_todos
title: List Project To-dos
description: Read the opt-in per-job Project To-do surface. Pass jobId for the employer view (categories, item definitions, roster without emails, all assignments) or contractId for an EXACT contract read: the worker's own effective list + history and blocking state, or for employers exactly that contract's assignments in every status, a roster of one (even when the contract is ended/offboarded/closed; empty when no worker is linked), and the `contract` lifecycle projection (null on job-wide reads; never names other contracts). assignedTo is the employer alias for contractId (requires jobId); a jobId supplied with a contract selector must match the contract's job for workers and employers alike (BAD_REQUEST CONTRACT_JOB_MISMATCH) and never widens the read. Cursor-paged with stable assignment ids and immutable per-assignment evidence/event audit history. Disabled jobs read as enabled=false with an empty, inert surface. Requires project_todos:read, the default-off project-todos agent surface, and a claimed account.

jobId.description: Job id for the employer view.

contractId.description: Exact contract read: the worker's own effective list + history, or for employers exactly this contract (roster of one, all statuses, `contract` lifecycle projection). Never widens to the job roster.

itemId.description: Filter assignments by logical item id.

assignedTo.description: Employer job view: filter to one contract id.

needsReview.description: true returns only submitted assignments awaiting employer review.

includeArchived.description: Include archived logical items/categories in the employer catalog.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from a previous page (nextCursor).

all.description: true collects EVERY page: follows nextCursor to exhaustion at a contract-valid page size (limit caps each page, never above 100; cursor may seed the start) and returns collection metadata {pageSize, pagesFetched, collectedCount, complete, finalCursor} alongside the merged result. Use this for job/project sweeps instead of raising limit past the documented maximum.

collection.description: Present only for all=true sweeps: exhaustive-collection metadata.

name: opentrain_set_project_availability_timezone
title: Set Project Availability Time Zone
description: Set the canonical job-scoped IANA reporting time zone shared by the employer UI, API, CLI, and MCP. Optional expectedCurrentTimeZone provides compare-and-set safety. Does not modify worker schedules or assignments. Idempotent; requires project_todos:write.

name: opentrain_preflight_project_todo
title: Preview a Project To-do operation (no write)
description: NO-WRITE safety preview for create, update+reissue, assign, archive, or a future-hire policy change. Provider-owned assignment previews return each masked recipient decision (first-time invite, re-invite, preserve unfinished, or preserve resolved) and exact side effects. Future-policy previews return before/after state and a request-bound signed receipt. Use before every employer mutation. Requires project_todos:write.

audience.description: Required for create_item, update_item with reissue, and assign.

selectedContractIds.description: SELECTED only: exact same-job active contracts; at least one required.

itemId.description: Required for update_item, assign, archive_item, and set_future_assignment.

enabled.description: Required for set_future_assignment: exact policy state to preview.

name: opentrain_create_project_todo
title: Create a Project To-do safely

audience.description: REQUIRED; omission never defaults to a broad audience.

preflightReceipt.description: Required for ACTIVE, FUTURE, and ACTIVE_AND_FUTURE.

version.description: Immutable definition. Requires title and type; supports description, content, sourceInstructionPageId, priority, blocking, due offset, evidence/module config.

name: opentrain_assign_project_todo
title: Assign an existing Project To-do safely
description: Assign an existing To-do. SELECTED requires exact selectedContractIds and never includes future hires. Broad audiences and provider-owned setup assignments require a matching signed preflight receipt. Provider-owned results distinguish first-time invites, re-invites after close, preserved unfinished work, and preserved resolved work; retries converge. Requires project_todos:write.

name: opentrain_set_project_todo_future_assignment
title: Set Project To-do Future Assignment Policy
description: Confirm an exact future-hire auto-assignment policy change for one existing Project To-do. First call opentrain_preflight_project_todo with operation=set_future_assignment and the same jobId, itemId, and enabled value; then pass the returned request-bound receipt. This changes only future-hire policy and does not fan out assignments immediately. Requires project_todos:write.

preflightReceipt.description: Receipt from the exact matching set_future_assignment preflight.

name: opentrain_archive_project_todo
title: Archive a Project To-do
description: Archive one To-do with a mandatory audit reason. First preflight operation=archive_item to inspect the exact open assignments that will close. Submissions and append-only history remain; restore is not supported by the agent surface. Requires project_todos:write.

name: opentrain_manage_project_todo
title: Manage a Project To-do
description: Advanced backward-compatible Project To-do action union. Prefer the focused preflight/create/assign/archive/future-policy tools because their schemas expose mandatory safety rules. preflight is no-write and omits idempotencyKey; every mutation requires a stable idempotencyKey. Requires project_todos:write.

action.description: Which Project To-do preview or mutation to perform. Prefer the focused opentrain_preview_project_todo_activation / opentrain_activate_project_todo / opentrain_reorder_project_todo_items tools for the activation family, and opentrain_preview_project_todo_hold / opentrain_hold_project_todo / opentrain_release_project_todo_hold for per-person holds (DEV-2832).

idempotencyKey.description: Client idempotency key; deterministic retries converge.

operation.description: preflight: exact operation to preview without writing.

enabled.description: set_enabled: turn the module on/off; set_future_assignment: exact future-hire policy state.

categoryId.description: create_item: category id; reorder_items: the category being reordered.

audience.description: create_item / assign: who receives the obligation. Required for those actions — there is no default; omission is rejected instead of fanning out to active contracts.

autoAssignNewHires.description: create_item: keep the item armed for future hires.

preflightReceipt.description: Broad create/update/assign or set_future_assignment: receipt from the exact matching preflight.

allowDuplicate.description: create_item: explicit override for an exact active duplicate warning.

version.description: create_item / update_item: immutable version definition (title, type, priority, blockingMode/Scope, dueOffsetMinutes, completionConfig — actionUrl must be absolute http(s); INTEGRATION_ACTION requires provider — and optional activationRule gating assignments SCHEDULED until satisfied; on update_item an omitted activationRule keeps the current rule and null removes it).

itemId.description: update_item / archive_item / assign / activation_preview: item id.

rule.description: activation_preview: presence-sensitive draft rule. OMITTED = evaluate the item's CURRENT rule (itemId required); EXPLICIT null = preview REMOVING the gate (predicts OPEN); an object = evaluate the draft before publishing.

orderedItemIds.description: reorder_items: the category's complete non-archived item id set, in display order (display only — never a prerequisite).

subjects.description: hold_preview / hold / release_hold: the PEOPLE the hold names — contracts of the job (hired) and/or proposals of the job (candidates not hired yet; the hold then binds the hire-time auto-assignment). At least one id, at most 100 in total; every id must belong to the job.

releaseRule.description: hold_preview / hold: optional automatic release condition in the activation-rule shape. Example — release after the LMS course to-do COMPLETED (system-verified PASS): {"schemaVersion":1,"mode":"ALL","predicates":[{"kind":"todo_completed","itemId":"<LMS course to-do item id>"}]}. Omit or null = manual release only.

assign.description: update_item: reissue the new version to this audience.

reason.description: archive_item / review RETURN/WAIVE/CLOSE / activate: required audited reason.

name: opentrain_preview_project_todo_activation
title: Preview Project To-do activation (no write)
description: STRICTLY NO-WRITE activation preview for ordered/prerequisite-driven to-dos. For an item's current immutable activation rule (itemId) or a draft rule (rule: schemaVersion 1, mode ALL|ANY, predicates todo_completed{itemId, satisfaction COMPLETED_ONLY default | COMPLETED_OR_WAIVED opt-in} / after_delay{anchor ASSIGNED|CONTRACT_START, offsetMinutes}) and an audience, returns each matched contract's predicted initial state (OPEN vs SCHEDULED — gated work is born SCHEDULED, invisible to the worker, no due/blocking, and a gated provider item stays DORMANT and does not invite/provision until activation) plus exactly which predicates are unmet, including the loud 'prerequisite not assigned to this person' warning. Display order never implies a prerequisite. Requires project_todos:read.

itemId.description: Preview this item's CURRENT rule (omit rule).

rule.description: Draft activation rule to preview before publishing (schemaVersion 1, mode ALL|ANY, predicates).

audience.description: Whose predicted activation state to preview.

name: opentrain_preview_project_todo_hold
title: Preview a per-person Project To-do hold (no write)
description: STRICTLY NO-WRITE (DEV-2832). For ONE to-do item and the named people — contracts of the job (hired) and/or proposals of the job (candidates not hired yet) — reports what placing a hold would do for each of them RIGHT NOW: HELD_AT_HIRE (not hired yet: the future-hire auto-assignment will create their copy SCHEDULED), HELD_PENDING_ASSIGNMENT (hired, no live copy: the next fan-out is born SCHEDULED), HELD (their SCHEDULED copy now also waits for the hold), ALREADY_ACTIVE (they already hold an activated copy — activation is one-way, so the hold has no live effect; the preview warns), RESOLVED (already completed/waived). Also returns their current assignment and the live evaluation of the optional draft releaseRule (e.g. "LMS course to-do COMPLETED" — the LMS to-do completes only from the system-verified PASS). Nobody outside the named people appears or is affected. Requires project_todos:read.

itemId.description: The to-do item to hold (e.g. the Feather onboarding to-do).

subjects.description: hold_preview / hold / release_hold: the PEOPLE the hold names — contracts of the job (hired) and/or proposals of the job (candidates not hired yet; the hold then binds the hire-time auto-assignment). At least one id, at most 100 in total; every id must belong to the job.

releaseRule.description: hold_preview / hold: optional automatic release condition in the activation-rule shape. Example — release after the LMS course to-do COMPLETED (system-verified PASS): {"schemaVersion":1,"mode":"ALL","predicates":[{"kind":"todo_completed","itemId":"<LMS course to-do item id>"}]}. Omit or null = manual release only.

holds.description: DEV-2832 hold_preview / hold / release_hold: one row per named person. effect (previews and hold): HELD_AT_HIRE — not hired yet, the future-hire fan-out will create the assignment SCHEDULED; HELD_PENDING_ASSIGNMENT — contract but no live assignment, the next fan-out is born SCHEDULED; HELD — a SCHEDULED assignment now also waits for the hold; ALREADY_ACTIVE — an activated copy exists, activation is one-way, no live effect (warning); RESOLVED — already completed/waived. outcome: CREATED | ALREADY_HELD (hold), RELEASED | NOT_HELD (release_hold), null (preview). releasePredicates: live evaluation of the release rule for the person (empty before the hire or without a rule).
