name: opentrain_hold_project_todo
title: Hold a Project To-do for selected people (per-person exclusion)
description: DEV-2832: place a per-person hold on ONE to-do item for the named contracts and/or proposals. While the hold is ACTIVE, every assignment of that item created for each named person — a manual assign or the hire-time future-hire auto-assignment — is born SCHEDULED: worker-invisible, no due/blocking schedule, no notification, provider-dormant. It opens only when the hold is released: by opentrain_release_project_todo_hold, by the audited opentrain_activate_project_todo override, or AUTOMATICALLY once the optional releaseRule is satisfied for that person (e.g. {"schemaVersion":1,"mode":"ALL","predicates":[{"kind":"todo_completed","itemId":"<LMS course to-do item id>"}]} — the LMS to-do completes only from the system-verified PASS; WAIVED does not count under the default COMPLETED_ONLY). A hold NEVER changes anyone else’s obligations, never re-locks an already-activated assignment (preview first: ALREADY_ACTIVE), and is one ACTIVE hold per item and person (placing again converges as ALREADY_HELD). Use it BEFORE the hire to beat the hire-time auto-assignment race. Requires project_todos:write, a required audited reason, and a stable idempotencyKey (same key + same payload replays; a different payload is a 409).

name: opentrain_export_project_todos_csv
title: Export Project To-dos CSV
description: Export one job's Project To-do assignments as the canonical spreadsheet-formula-neutralized CSV. The worker_email column is redacted on agent surfaces (personal emails never leave the platform). The export is one response with no row cap (one row per person and assigned to-do). delivery=inline (default) returns the CSV in structuredContent. delivery=resource returns a compact receipt (rowCount, asOf, filename, byteSize, sha256, contentType, resourceUri) plus a resource_link; the rows never enter the result — read opentrain://jobs/{jobId}/project-todos/export/csv when you need the bytes. Both deliveries are bounded by the export route's response, which the hosting platform caps at about 4.5 MB of JSON (HTTP 413 above it, on every surface); the resource's own 20 MiB ceiling is not reached in practice. There is NO snapshot: a resource read re-fetches the LIVE export, so its _meta.sha256 equals the receipt hash only if no row changed in between. Cost: the receipt is a few hundred bytes, but receipt + read is larger than the inline result; use resource when you need only the receipt or your host keeps resource bytes out of your context. Requires project_todos:read.

name: opentrain_quiz_grounding_snapshot
title: Instructions grounding snapshot for quiz authoring (read-only)
description: READ-ONLY. The job's RELEASED effective Instructions pages (the version workers see; Google Doc pages are read live) with their content checksums, the effective instruction-set id and the page-tree checksum — exactly what to pin into a quiz draft's definition.grounding after you read the pages with the Instructions tools (page reads carry the stable block ids, attrs.id, that sourceRefs cite). A job with no released Instructions answers 409 INSTRUCTIONS_NOT_RELEASED. Pass draftPreview: true ONLY when the user asks to ground on unreleased edits: the result carries source: draft_preview and a previewLabel to show the user, and form_publish refuses it with 409 GROUNDING_DRAFT_PREVIEW until the Instructions are released and you re-capture without draftPreview (a preview is never promoted). Copy the returned `grounding` block verbatim; then give each grounded question sourceRefs: [{ pageId, nodeId }] (≤ 20; pageId must be pinned) and an optional rationale (≤ 2000 chars). Workers never see either. Page reads return the employer's DRAFT by default: write every grounded question from the RELEASED text (opentrain_job_instructions_read_page with released: true; its checksum equals the pinned one). Each page of a released snapshot carries draftDiffers: true when the unreleased draft of that page differs or could not be read to compare (always false for Google Doc pages, which are read live); never take question text from the draft of such a page. Never creates an instruction set; resolving the released view may record the same idempotent effective-view row a worker read records. Requires project_todos:read AND instructions:read, a claimed account and the default-off project-todos agent surface.

draftPreview.description: Ground on the UNRELEASED draft as a labeled preview that cannot be published (default false: released Instructions). Only when the user asks for it.

source.description: Which Instructions version was read. `released` (the default) is the version workers see and the only one a quiz publishes from. `draft_preview` (requested with draftPreview=true) reads unreleased edits, is labeled on every surface, and publish refuses it with 409 GROUNDING_DRAFT_PREVIEW until the Instructions are released and the grounding is re-captured. Responses carry it only on a draft preview; an absent source is `released`.

previewLabel.description: Present only for a `draft_preview` grounding: the preview label to show the user. Absent for released Instructions.

draftDiffers.description: Released captures only, and only when the X-OpenTrain-Features header names quiz-grounding-draft-differs-v1: true when the job’s unreleased draft of this page differs from the released content, no longer has the page, or could not be read to compare (the snapshot never fails on an unreadable draft). Write questions on such a page from the released text (Instructions page read with released=true), never the draft. Always false for GOOGLE_DOC pages (read live: released = draft). Absent otherwise.

grounding.description: The block to copy verbatim into `definition.grounding` (schemaVersion 2). Each answerable question may then carry `sourceRefs: [{ pageId, nodeId }]` (≤ 20; pageId must be pinned here; nodeId is a stable TipTap block `attrs.id` on that page) and an optional `rationale` (≤ 2000 chars). Workers never see either.

source.description: Which Instructions version was read. `released` (the default) is the version workers see and the only one a quiz publishes from. `draft_preview` (requested with draftPreview=true) reads unreleased edits, is labeled on every surface, and publish refuses it with 409 GROUNDING_DRAFT_PREVIEW until the Instructions are released and the grounding is re-captured. Responses carry it only on a draft preview; an absent source is `released`.

name: opentrain_validate_quiz_draft
title: Validate a quiz draft or candidate (no write)
description: NO-WRITE validation of a job-local quiz: every schema finding, publication-rule finding, form-state gate (FORM_ARCHIVED, ASSET_UNUSABLE, GROUNDING_DRAFT_PREVIEW — a draft-preview grounding never publishes; the grounding in the result then carries source: draft_preview and the previewLabel) and Instructions-grounding finding at once. Pass formId to validate the STORED draft, or jobId + definition + settings to validate a CANDIDATE before creating it (never both). publishable: false with affectedQuestionIds tells you exactly which questions to fix; a grounded draft reports SOURCE_CHANGED here (ERROR findings name the questions whose cited pages/blocks drifted — only cited pages are read; TREE_CHANGED is a non-blocking warning; DRAFT_DIFFERS is a non-blocking warning naming the questions on a cited page whose unreleased draft differs from the released text workers see, DRAFT_UNREADABLE when that draft could not be read — re-read those pages with opentrain_job_instructions_read_page released: true and make sure each named question matches the released text, never the draft) before opentrain_manage_project_todo_quiz form_publish would refuse it with the same findings as 409. Read scope, no idempotency key. Nothing users see changes; for a grounded draft, resolving the released view may record the same idempotent effective-view row a worker read records. Requires project_todos:read (plus instructions:read when the definition carries a grounding block), a claimed account and the default-off project-todos agent surface.

jobId.description: Candidate: the job the form will be created in.

result.description: Closed NO-WRITE `form_validate` result: every schema, publication-rule and grounding finding at once. `publishable` is false whenever any SCHEMA/PUBLICATION finding or an ERROR grounding finding exists.

publishable.description: The one verdict. A "not publishable" report is still a 200 success (no reserved `ok` field).

code.description: Content rules plus the gates publish enforces: FORM_ARCHIVED (restore first), ASSET_UNUSABLE (a referenced media asset is missing, still uploading or from another job), LEARNING_PLAN_MISMATCH (the stored confirmed learning plan does not fit this definition/settings — publish would refuse with 409 LEARNING_PLAN_MISMATCH) and GROUNDING_DRAFT_PREVIEW (the grounding was captured from unreleased Instructions — publish refuses with 409 GROUNDING_DRAFT_PREVIEW; release the Instructions, re-capture the grounding, then publish).

source.description: Present only when the definition grounding is a draft preview (publish refuses it; see the GROUNDING_DRAFT_PREVIEW finding). Absent for a released grounding or no grounding.

previewLabel.description: Present only for a `draft_preview` grounding: the preview label to show the user. Absent for released Instructions.

items.description: One SOURCE_CHANGED finding. ERROR findings block publication and name exactly the questions whose cited pages/blocks drifted (only pages some question cites are read; uncited pins never block); TREE_CHANGED is a WARNING (titles/order moved, cited content checked per page). DRAFT_DIFFERS / DRAFT_UNREADABLE are non-blocking WARNINGs on form_validate only, for a released grounding, sent only to callers whose X-OpenTrain-Features header names quiz-grounding-draft-differs-v1: the unreleased draft of that cited page differs from the released version workers see (or could not be read to compare), so check the named questions against the released text (Instructions page read with released=true), never the draft. name: opentrain_plan_quiz_rollout
title: Plan a quiz rollout: publish + assign preview (no write)
description: NO-WRITE rollout plan for a job-local quiz (registry preflight project_todos.quizzes.rollout.plan; KEYLESS by design). Choose the source — DRAFT at the expectedDraftRevision you reviewed (confirming publishes it as the next immutable version) or an already-published VERSION (confirming only binds it) — and the To-Do policy (completionPolicy, audience, required/priority/blockingMode/dueOffsetMinutes, optional title/description/categoryId). Returns blockers (PROJECT_TODOS_DISABLED, FORM_ARCHIVED, DRAFT_REVISION_STALE, DRAFT_INVALID, NOT_PUBLISHABLE, ASSET_UNUSABLE, SOURCE_CHANGED, GROUNDING_DRAFT_PREVIEW, LEARNING_PLAN_MISMATCH, ON_PASS_REQUIRES_*), warnings (duplicates, already-published draft revision, empty audience, grounding warnings), the exact publication facts, projected due/blocking times, the MASKED live roster, active duplicate To-Dos, the notification impact, and — only when publishable — plan.token (signed, constant-size digests only, expires in 15 minutes, bound to the form content hash, a digest of the To-Do policy and the recipient set). Show the plan to the user and confirm in the conversation; no OpenTrain page is required. Nothing users see changes; for a grounded DRAFT, resolving the released view may record the same idempotent effective-view row a worker read records. Requires project_todos:read (plus instructions:read when the draft is grounded in Instructions), a claimed account and the default-off project-todos agent surface.

oneOf.description: Publish the current draft at the revision the agent reviewed, then bind it.
Bind an already-published immutable version (no publish).

todo.description: The To-Do configuration the agent reviewed with the user. Required: completionPolicy and audience. Defaults: required true, priority URGENT, blockingMode IMMEDIATE, title/description from the form.

plan.description: Present only when publishable; expires after 15 minutes.

name: opentrain_confirm_quiz_rollout
title: Confirm a planned quiz rollout (publish + bind + assign)
description: Confirm a planned quiz rollout (registry op project_todos.quizzes.rollout.confirm). Takes plan.token from opentrain_plan_quiz_rollout, the EXACT same todo the plan reviewed (the token signs its digest; a different todo is 409 PLAN_TODO_MISMATCH) and a STABLE idempotencyKey. Before any write it re-checks that Project To-dos are still enabled and that the live roster equals the planned recipient set; then it publishes the planned draft (or binds the planned version), creates the Project To-do, and assigns the roster — each step idempotent under the key, so a retry with the SAME key converges on the same ids (replayed: true) and never double-publishes or double-assigns, and the same plan cannot be confirmed under a second key (409 TARGET_ALREADY_MUTATED). Any drift since the plan fails closed as 409 PLAN_STALE with details.changed (roster | projectTodosEnabled | draftRevision | content | archived | job | form) and nothing written; if the refusal happens after this rollout’s own publication, details.published names the version and the receipt is kept so a retry with the SAME key resumes it (or plan again with source VERSION). An expired or foreign token is 409 PLAN_TOKEN_EXPIRED / PLAN_TOKEN_INVALID — plan again, never retry blindly. An exact duplicate of an active To-Do is refused unless allowDuplicate: true. Requires project_todos:write.

todo.description: The EXACT To-Do configuration passed to quiz_rollout_plan (the token signs its digest, never its contract ids or text); any difference is 409 PLAN_TODO_MISMATCH.

allowDuplicate.description: Explicit override of the exact-duplicate active To-Do refusal.

createdNow.description: True when THIS confirm published the version (false: planned VERSION or resumed).

resumed.description: True when this rollout had published the version on an earlier attempt and this confirm resumed it (false: published now, or a planned VERSION that was only bound).

Plus the grading state, pass rule, release mode, the current provenance, the full revision history with provenance (AGENT vs HUMAN, model, confidence, rubric version) and a nextAction. Grade with opentrain_manage_project_todo_quiz action grade (per-question awardedPoints within allowedPoints, plus provenance), then release. Requires project_todos:read, a claimed account and the default-off project-todos agent surface.

name: opentrain_list_integrations

description: List provider-neutral job integrations: every registered project-action provider adapter with masked connection state (never credentials), mapping status, and provisioning capability for one job. jobId.description: Job id to list integrations for.

name: opentrain_get_integration_status
title: Get Masked Integration Status
description: Read the masked status of one provider on one job: connection health (masked credential suffix + external organization id only), project mapping with last sync state, and per-contract enrollment/verification records with masked invite addresses. Secrets and raw credentials are never returned. Requires integrations:read and employer provider access.

jobId.description: Job id the integration is mapped to.

includeProviderReadback.description: Opt in to live provider readback (active member / pending invite counts) inside organizationHealth. Off by default so polling never consumes the provider rate budget.

name: opentrain_update_integration_config
title: Update Masked Integration Configuration
description: Update masked integration configuration for one job: enabled=true with externalProjectId maps/activates the provider project without inviting any hires; assign the returned setupTodo.itemId through opentrain_manage_project_todo action=assign. enabled=false disables the mapping and archives the setup obligation while retaining history. Credential connect/disconnect stays in the web app; no secret material is accepted or returned. Requires integrations:write and employer provider access.

enabled.description: true maps/activates the provider project; false disables the mapping.

externalProjectId.description: Required when enabling: the provider-side project id to map.

name: opentrain_assign_integration
title: Assign an Integration to a Contract
description: Deprecated compatibility wrapper for assigning one contract. Prefer opentrain_manage_project_todo action=assign on the provider setup to-do so every audience and audit operation uses the single Project To-dos control plane. Replay safe; requires integrations:write and employer provider access.

contractId.description: Hired contract to provision into the provider.

name: opentrain_reconcile_integration
title: Reconcile Integration State
description: Reconcile one contract's provider state through the fail-closed verified-fact choke point. A provider-ready time integration can queue a bounded fresh-proof probe and return CHECK_QUEUED/CHECK_RUNNING plus retry guidance. Employers reconcile any contract on their jobs; workers only their own. Requires integrations:write.

assignmentId.description: Optional exact obligation; omit for a contract-wide reconcile.

name: opentrain_verify_integration
title: Verify an Integration Obligation
description: Run an assignment-scoped integration verification check through the exact-obligation choke point. A provider-ready time integration can queue a bounded fresh-proof probe and returns its check state, next action, and retry guidance. Employers verify any contract on their jobs; workers only their own. Requires integrations:write.

assignmentId.description: The exact worker obligation to verify.

repoId.description: HuggingFace LeRobot dataset repo id (org/name) for LEROBOT imports.

mcapUrl.description: MCAP recording URL for MCAP imports.

name: opentrain_get_robot_episodes
title: List Robot Episodes + QA Flags

name: opentrain_search_catalog

space.description: Embedding space: CLIP (media), TEXT (long-text mpnet), or MIXED (both, default).

name: opentrain_catalog_health
title: Open Label Dataset Health Report
description: Compute an Open Label project's Dataset Health read-model: annotation coverage, class-balance histograms, metadata stats, and potential split leaks.

name: opentrain_cut_dataset_version
title: Cut an Immutable Dataset Version
description: Cut an immutable, content-hashed version snapshot of an Open Label dataset. Snapshots list and diff by canonical content hash.

name: opentrain_create_job_draft
title: Create OpenTrain Job Draft
description: Create an unpublished OpenTrain job draft from a plain-text job description, canonical job object, or supported import payload. Drafting never publishes by itself. Before drafting, ask the human (never guess): pay type, pay range (minimum, maximum and target rate), number of hires, hours or labels per person or total volume, locations and English level, and for admin accounts the internal client and job name. Create ONE job per customer engagement covering labelers and reviewers/QC; describe the reviewer role and its rate in the same job. Give the human the reviewUrl: it opens the Review step, which lists anything left and holds the Publish button. To screen applicants with a quiz, ask the human and link a published LMS course with opentrain_lms_link_job_course (stage SCREENING) BEFORE publishing: proposals submitted before the link are not enrolled.

jobDescription.description: Full plain-text job description or project brief.

idempotencyKey.description: Optional idempotency key to avoid duplicate drafts on retry.

name: opentrain_update_job_draft_fields
title: Update OpenTrain Job Draft Fields
description: Patch fields on an existing unpublished OpenTrain job draft. Use this after asking the human for missing field answers.

patch.description: Draft field patch keyed by OpenTrain field names.

name: opentrain_discard_job_draft
title: Discard an OpenTrain Job Draft
description: Discard (delete) a never-published OpenTrain job draft so it no longer appears in the job list. Only drafts that were never published, have no proposals and are in no folder can be discarded, and only by an organization owner; a published job is closed in OpenTrain instead. Pass confirm=true. Idempotent: a repeat call reports alreadyDiscarded.

confirm.description: Must be true: discarding deletes the draft.

name: opentrain_verify_batch_results

name: opentrain_verify_reward

description: POST /verify/reward: mode judge_now scores {prompt, response} items synchronously via the LLM judge; mode human_async queues them for human verdicts (poll opentrain_verify_batch_results or GET /verify/reward/{batchId}). Returns rewards in [0,1].

items.description: Items: {prompt, response, id?}.

title: Inspect Canonical Job Instructions
description: Inspect the exact instruction tree displayed in one job Instructions tab, including the employer URL and folder-lock metadata. No standalone Instructions Studio exists.

digest.description: true = add conditionalRead.digest to the result, so a later repeat read can pass it as ifNoneMatch. Default false: the result is unchanged.

ifNoneMatch.description: The conditionalRead.digest (24 lowercase hex characters) of a result you already hold, from any OpenTrain surface (CLI meta.digest is the same digest). Unchanged: result is withheld and conditionalRead.notModified is true, with hasMore/nextCursor/truncated kept. Changed: the full result with notModified false and the new digest. A result carrying a JobOps sync delivery is never withheld.

name: opentrain_job_instructions_read_page
title: Read Canonical Job Instruction Page
description: Read one canonical job instruction page as rich TipTap JSON. By default this is the employer's DRAFT (preserve its checksum for safe patch/replace writes), which workers may not see yet. Pass released: true to read the page exactly as workers see it (the job's released Instructions; Google Doc pages live): write quiz questions grounded with opentrain_quiz_grounding_snapshot from this text, never the draft; its content.checksum equals the pinned one. A job with nothing released answers 409 INSTRUCTIONS_NOT_RELEASED; a page that is not released (draft only) answers 404 PAGE_NOT_RELEASED. Requires instructions:read. One page can pass the 25,000-token default MCP output limit (a page's TipTap document may be up to 2 MiB). delivery=inline (default) returns the whole page. delivery=resource returns a receipt (location, page, content.schemaVersion, content.checksum, content.topLevelBlockCount, resourceUri, contentType, byteSize, sha256) and a resource_link; the document never enters the result — read the resource when you need it (opentrain://jobs/{jobId}/instructions/pages/{pageId}, with /released for released: true). focus returns ONE part of the page exactly, never truncated, beside the whole page's content.checksum (use it as expectedChecksum for a patch): { nodeId } = the node whose attrs.id is that id, at any depth, with its JSON pointer; { blocks: { start, end } } = top-level blocks start (inclusive) to end (exclusive); { pointer } = the RFC 6901 pointer's value inside content.doc (for example /content/3). A missing node, an id on more than one node, a range past content.topLevelBlockCount or a pointer that resolves to nothing is an error, never a partial page. focus and delivery=resource cannot be combined.

released.description: true = the page as workers see it (released Instructions; result.source: released). Default false: the employer draft.

delivery.description: inline (default): the whole page in the result. resource: a receipt (no document) and a resource_link; read the resource for the document.

focus.description: Exactly one of { nodeId } (the node with that attrs.id), { blocks: { start, end } } (top-level blocks, end exclusive) or { pointer } (RFC 6901, inside content.doc). Returns that part exactly with the whole page checksum. Not with delivery=resource.

name: opentrain_job_instructions_page_link
title: Resolve Canonical Job Instruction Page Link
description: Return the canonical actor-aware URL for one job Instructions page. Optionally validate a stable TipTap node anchor before returning an anchor URL.

name: opentrain_job_instructions_history_list
title: List Job Instruction Draft Checkpoints
description: List a page’s immutable draft checkpoints, newest first — content-free summaries (provenance, actor, timestamps, digests, sizes) with a page-bound versioned cursor. A foreign or malformed cursor fails deterministically with INVALID_CURSOR. Collaboration-room identifiers are never exposed.

name: opentrain_job_instructions_search
title: Search Job Instructions
description: Search a job’s effective draft Instructions (job_instructions.search): the employer editor’s ranked full-text search (typo-tolerant fallback) over the job’s own instruction set plus the folder set it inherits — exactly what this token reads through inspect and read_page; never a worker’s released view. Returns page groups (up to five block hits each) with stable block ids, anchor ids for deep links, the nearest heading, and inert plain-text snippets with code-point highlight ranges. Hits are ranked inside a bounded window: truncated=true means the window filled — narrow the query rather than page on. Pagination is over the ranked page groups with an opaque cursor bound to the job, the query and the ranked window (a foreign cursor, or one issued before the Instructions changed, fails with INVALID_CURSOR — restart without a cursor). Read-only.

name: opentrain_job_instructions_revision
title: Read Job Instructions Revision Token
description: Read a job’s Instructions revision token (job_instructions.revision.get): the durable change signal for cheap polling — the job set’s revision counter and the inherited folder set’s, folded into one comparable revisionToken. Compare it to the last value you saw: a different token means a committed structure or content change (or a folder membership change) of what workers read through the job; it says THAT something changed, never what — read inspect / read_page / history / releases for the content. There is no durable event log or webhook. Read-only.

name: opentrain_job_instructions_compliance
title: List Job Instruction Read Required Compliance
description: List a job’s Read Required compliance (job_instructions.compliance.list): the employer compliance matrix the dashboard shows — per participating contract, the worker’s state against the job’s published releases (NO_REVIEW_REQUIRED / SYNCING / ACTION_REQUIRED / MARKED_READ / UNDERSTOOD), the outstanding count and the last read / understood timestamps. Workers are referenced by workerUserId with a masked display name. Employer-only (worker acknowledgments never cross this surface) and gated by the Read Required rollout for the actor: outside it the read is a 404 like the release tools. Keyset pagination: hasMore/nextCursor. Read-only.

name: opentrain_job_instructions_compliance_remind
title: Remind Workers To Read Required Job Instructions
description: Remind the workers who have not acknowledged one Read Required release of a job (job_instructions.compliance.remind). Sends the existing in-app reminder: it names the job, says its Instructions need reading and links to them (no free text). Each worker gets at most one reminder per release — a repeat by anyone answers ALREADY_REMINDED for that worker and sends nothing; a newer release allows a new reminder. Every handled worker gets a row: REMINDED, ALREADY_REMINDED, ALREADY_ACKNOWLEDGED, NOT_REQUIRED, NOT_ON_JOB (left or ended), ACCOUNT_INACTIVE (banned, closed or deletion pending), NOTIFICATIONS_OFF (the worker turned off in-app Read Required reminders; nothing sent or recorded) or FAILED (nothing recorded; retry with a new idempotencyKey). releaseId comes from the job’s releases (a READ_REQUIRED release of the job or its folder); a release still being delivered answers 409 CONFLICT (RELEASE_SYNCING, retry shortly) and one whose delivery failed answers 409 INSTRUCTIONS_RELEASE_DELIVERY_FAILED (permanent: do not retry; a newer release can be reminded). Without workerUserIds it handles 100 workers per call: follow nextCursor. idempotencyKey is REQUIRED; a retry with it replays the stored result. Employer-only and gated by the Read Required rollout (outside it: 404).

name: opentrain_job_instructions_history_read
title: Read Job Instruction Draft Checkpoint
description: Read one immutable draft checkpoint: canonical TipTap JSON, plain text, provenance, and digest. Read-only — no historical collaboration session is mounted, and storage/checksum reads never prove collaboration sync or browser rendering.

name: opentrain_job_instructions_history_compare
title: Compare Job Instruction Draft Checkpoint
description: Stable-block diff between a checkpoint and the CURRENT live document (default) or another checkpoint. Direction is checkpoint → target: blocks ADDED since the checkpoint would be REMOVED by restoring it, and REMOVED blocks come back. The current side includes the live checksum for a conflict-aware restore.

name: opentrain_job_instructions_history_checkpoint
title: Save Manual Job Instruction Checkpoint
description: Pin the provider-confirmed live document as a MANUAL draft checkpoint. Convergent by content digest (created=false truthfully reports an unchanged document). Provide idempotencyKey to make the write receipt-tracked so retries replay.

name: opentrain_job_instructions_history_restore
title: Restore Job Instruction Draft Checkpoint
description: DESTRUCTIVE: replace the live page content with a historical checkpoint. Run history_compare first. The server verifies expectedChecksum against the live document (409 on concurrent edits), durably pins the pre-restore content as an undo baseline checkpoint, then moves the page to a FRESH collaboration session — an active session is never overwritten. confirmRestore=true AND confirmLive=true are REQUIRED (restore changes the canonical live worker document; collaboration/browser delivery remains unverified); idempotencyKey is REQUIRED so retries replay the durable receipt. Success proves storage + checksum readback only, never collaboration sync or browser rendering.

name: opentrain_job_instructions_preview

Use this before a confirmLive mutation. Optional pageId validates against that page’s persisted content schema version (e.g. version 2 admits details/callout); for a new page pass contentSchemaVersion (default 1), the value create will use.

icon.description: Bounded page icon ('emoji:<glyph>' | 'lucide:<name>'). Omit to leave the persisted icon untouched; null clears it.

contentSchemaVersion.description: NEW pages only (default 1). Existing pages keep their persisted content schema version.

name: opentrain_job_instructions_upload_image
title: Upload Canonical Job Instruction Image
description: Upload one image and return a URL for a TipTap image node. This does not change a page.

name: opentrain_job_instructions_create_page
title: Create Canonical Job Instruction Page
description: Create a rich page directly in the actual job Instructions tab. idempotencyKey is required. Optional contentSchemaVersion (1|2, default 1) sets the new page’s node set; v2 blocks (youtube/callout/details/audio/attachment) require the page’s contentSchemaVersion >= 2 — see schema_upgrade.

icon.description: Bounded page icon ('emoji:<glyph>' | 'lucide:<name>'). Omit to leave the persisted icon untouched; null clears it.

contentSchemaVersion.description: NEW pages only (default 1). Existing pages keep their persisted content schema version.

name: opentrain_job_instructions_patch_page
title: Patch Canonical Job Instruction Page
description: Apply stable-node rich-text patches. The last-read checksum prevents overwriting concurrent human edits. v2 blocks (youtube/callout/details/audio/attachment) require the page’s contentSchemaVersion >= 2; see schema_upgrade.

icon.description: Bounded page icon ('emoji:<glyph>' | 'lucide:<name>'). Omit to leave the persisted icon untouched; null clears it.

contentSchemaVersion.description: NEW pages only (default 1). Existing pages keep their persisted content schema version.

name: opentrain_job_instructions_replace_page
title: Replace Canonical Job Instruction Page

icon.description: Bounded page icon ('emoji:<glyph>' | 'lucide:<name>'). Omit to leave the persisted icon untouched; null clears it.

contentSchemaVersion.description: NEW pages only (default 1). Existing pages keep their persisted content schema version.

name: opentrain_job_instructions_update_page
title: Update Canonical Job Instruction Page
description: Rename, reparent, reorder, or set the identity icon ('emoji:<glyph>' | 'lucide:<name>'; null clears) of a page in the actual job Instructions tab.

name: opentrain_job_instructions_archive_page
title: Archive Canonical Job Instruction Page
description: Archive one page from the actual job Instructions tab. Requires confirmArchive=true.

name: opentrain_job_instructions_schema_upgrade
title: Upgrade Job Instruction Page Content Schema
description: Upgrade one canonical page from content schema v1 to v2 (details/callout/youtube/audio/attachment blocks). Two-step quiesce workflow: action "request" opens a PENDING upgrade and freezes new write-token issuance; wait until the returned quiesceReadyAt passes, then action "complete" performs the cutover. "status" reports the current state without changing anything. Every action is convergent and idempotent — no idempotencyKey is needed. An already-v2 page reports COMPLETED with alreadyUpgraded=true.

name: opentrain_job_instructions_youtube_node
title: Build Job Instruction YouTube Node Locally
description: Build the schema-v2 TipTap youtube node for one pasted YouTube URL, entirely locally — no network call and no writes. Accepts watch, youtu.be, Shorts, live, embed, and /v/ URLs with a SINGLE optional t=/start= offset. STRICT rejection: playlists (list=), autoplay, tracking params (si, feature, pp, utm_*), any other query params or fragments, path suffixes after the id, both t and start together, channel URLs, non-YouTube hosts, and raw <iframe>/embed HTML. The default stable id is collision-safe and unique per call; pass nodeId for reproducible documents. Placing the node requires the page’s contentSchemaVersion >= 2 (see schema_upgrade).

name: opentrain_job_instructions_release_prepare
title: Prepare Job Instruction Release Candidate
description: Capture an immutable publish candidate from the job’s current instruction draft (expires in 30 minutes). Prepare and publish are two sequential operations, never atomic.

name: opentrain_job_instructions_release_preview
title: Preview Job Instruction Release Candidate
description: Preview a publish candidate: page delta, semantic impact classification, recommended delivery policy with reason codes, and affected-job/worker fan-out estimate. Read-only.

name: opentrain_job_instructions_release_publish
title: Publish Job Instruction Release
description: Publish a prepared candidate as the immutable release workers read. deliveryPolicy is REQUIRED and explicit — SILENT (visible, no worker notification/obligation), NOTIFY (notification, no obligation), or READ_REQUIRED (unread obligation + read/"I understand" + reminders). The release records the system recommendation and whether it was overridden.

name: opentrain_job_instructions_release_list
title: List Job Instruction Releases
description: List the job’s published instruction releases (seq, delivery policy, impact, override audit, active pointer) plus the unpublished-changes status. Read-only.

name: opentrain_job_instructions_video_prepare
title: Prepare Job Instruction Native Video Upload
description: Prepare a native Cloudflare Stream video upload for a writable page of this job (rollout-gated; fails closed with no legacy fallback). Returns a ONE-TIME direct TUS upload grant exactly once per idempotency key: the caller must transfer the file bytes itself with a TUS client (pinned tus-js-client 4.3.1) against uploadUrl — this tool NEVER carries file bytes, and the upload URL is never persisted or replayed. durationSeconds is REQUIRED (it sizes the provider storage reservation). A duplicate key returns the non-secret receipt with recovery guidance (cancel, then re-prepare under a NEW key).

name: opentrain_job_instructions_video_status
title: Read Job Instruction Native Video Status
description: Read native video status by canonical REST readback: storageReady (bytes accepted) vs playbackReady (READY) are distinct, and browserVerified is always false here — browser/collaboration rendering is only proven by the visual-review plan plus a real browser check.

name: opentrain_job_instructions_video_cancel
title: Cancel Job Instruction Native Video Upload
description: Cancel a native video upload you prepared, releasing its provider storage reservation. Exact status "canceled" confirms the release; "canceling" means the release is still pending (retry); "ready" means the asset became immutable first and cannot be canceled. A successful cancel removes the asset and your repeat still returns "canceled" (an uploader-bound server tombstone keyed by the asset id); an unknown id, or someone else’s video, is 404. Convergent — no idempotencyKey.

name: opentrain_job_instructions_asset_prepare
title: Prepare Job Instruction Private Audio / File Upload
description: Prepare a private AUDIO (audio/mpeg, audio/mp4, audio/ogg, audio/wav; ≤ 50 MiB) or FILE attachment (PDF, DOCX, XLSX, CSV, TXT; ≤ 25 MiB) upload for a writable page of this job. Returns a ONE-TIME signed PUT upload URL exactly once per idempotency key: PUT the bytes there yourself with exactly upload.contentType — this tool NEVER carries file bytes and the URL is never persisted or replayed — then call asset_finalize (server-side byte sniff + size bound) and insert the returned schema-v2 node (instructionAudio / instructionAttachment) on the page. A duplicate key returns the non-secret receipt with recovery guidance (cancel, then re-prepare under a NEW key).

contentType.description: Must belong to the chosen kind’s content-type set (enforced per kind by the server).

sizeBytes.description: audio ≤ 52428800 bytes, file ≤ 26214400 bytes (enforced per kind by the server).

kind.description: audio: audio/mpeg, audio/mp4, audio/ogg, audio/wav up to 52428800 bytes; file: application/pdf, application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document, application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet, text/csv, text/plain up to 26214400 bytes. The server enforces the chosen kind’s set and ceiling.

name: opentrain_job_instructions_asset_status
title: Read Job Instruction Private Audio / File Asset Status
description: Read a private audio / file attachment asset by canonical REST readback: PENDING (awaiting bytes or finalize), READY (verified and served at url) or ERRORED (terminal), with the verified size once READY and the exact node to insert. Video assets are read with video_status instead.

name: opentrain_job_instructions_asset_finalize
title: Finalize Job Instruction Private Audio / File Upload
description: Finalize an upload you prepared after the PUT completed: the server sniffs the stored bytes against the declared type, bounds the size and marks the asset READY, returning the delivery url and the node to insert. Convergent — an already-READY asset returns the same; an expired PENDING upload fails (prepare again); a rejection for size, type or signature removes the asset and your repeat returns the SAME rejection (an uploader-bound server tombstone keyed by the asset id); a repeat after your own cancel fails 400 (prepare a new upload). An unknown id, or someone else’s asset, is 404. No idempotencyKey.

name: opentrain_job_instructions_asset_cancel
title: Cancel Job Instruction Private Audio / File Upload
description: Cancel a PENDING private audio / file upload you prepared. Exact status "canceled" confirms the release; "canceling" means the release is still pending (repeat); "ready" means the asset was finalized first and stays (READY assets are never deleted). A successful cancel removes the asset and your repeat still returns "canceled" (an uploader-bound server tombstone keyed by the asset id), as does a cancel after your own rejected finalize; an unknown id, or someone else’s asset, is 404. Convergent — no idempotencyKey.

Reuses the original key via operationId. EXECUTOR_FENCED requires status/drain or explicit resume; committed-readback errors require the SAME operation, never another activation.

name: opentrain_cancel_folder_instruction_change
title: Cancel uncommitted folder Instructions change
description: Cancel an uncommitted reviewed operation with confirmed=true; originals remain retained and no partial destination is exposed. Cannot undo a committed operation: preview REVERSE instead. Safe same-operation retry.

name: opentrain_lms_rollout_course_version

description: DEV-2972 DESTRUCTIVE APPLY: rolls a published version out to active learners; every in-scope assignment is reclassified at APPLY time from live state, so learner progress drift never rejects the batch. Requires explicit confirmApply=true and an explicit audience (jobId and/or a non-empty assignmentIds selection). Eligible assignments migrate now (state carried), unsafe/mid-work queue for their next safe boundary, already-current/terminal skip idempotently, genuine incompatibility blocks that assignment only; per-assignment failures are isolated and reported as FAILED. Returns the durable batch receipt; replayed verbatim for the same idempotency key.

name: opentrain_lms_prepare_asset_upload
title: Prepare Direct LMS Asset Upload
description: Direct-to-storage upload, step 1 of 3 (prepare → upload → finalize). Idempotently reserves the asset and mints a short-lived tenant-scoped grant (signed PUT / TUS resumable). Not bound by the buffered API-route cap; capability discovery reports domain and effective provider ceilings separately (VIDEO currently 256 MiB). Replaying the key recovers the reservation (READY = already committed). The grant is a transit secret: upload with it, never log or persist it.

idempotencyKey.description: Durable-receipt idempotency key: 8-128 characters of letters, digits, dot, underscore, dash, or colon. Same key + same payload replays the stored receipt; same key + changed payload is a 409.

name: opentrain_lms_finalize_asset_upload
title: Finalize Direct LMS Asset Upload
description: Direct-to-storage upload, step 3 of 3. Requires idempotencyKey so a response-timeout retry replays one durable receipt. The server verifies the STORED object (observed length, streamed SHA-256, container signature) before committing READY; expectedSha256 is a cross-check only. Duplicate finalize returns the original READY asset; a verification mismatch fails the reservation closed (start over with a fresh key).

Ceilings: 5 MiB image, 32 MiB audio, 256 MiB video; kind must match the MIME family. Replaying the key returns READY once finalized. The grant is a transit secret: upload with it, never log or persist it. Reference the asset id from the question doc as an "image", "audio", or "video" node.

The server re-reads the stored object and verifies size, declared MIME type, container signature for the kind, and a server-computed SHA-256 before committing PENDING → READY; expectedSha256 is a cross-check only. Invalid bytes invalidate the reservation (start over with a fresh key); a duplicate finalize returns the READY asset.

name: opentrain_lms_get_attempt_evidence
title: Get Immutable Attempt Evidence
description: Read one attempt's full immutable evidence, rendered from the attempt's OWN pinned form version (never the current release). SUBMITTED attempts include the safe per-question snapshot (prompt/required/options/scale), the worker's answers, closed outcomes, and the current append-only manual grade; NOT_SUBMITTED attempts return honest nulls. Never returns answer keys, pass thresholds, or attempt policies. One attempt can pass the 25,000-token default MCP output limit (Native Forms allow 500 questions, 10,000-character prompts and 200 options). delivery=inline (default) returns the evidence in structuredContent. delivery=resource returns a compact receipt (the same result without questions, missedQuestionIds and unansweredQuestionIds, plus questionCount, missedQuestionCount, unansweredQuestionCount, resourceUri, contentType, byteSize, sha256) and a resource_link; the questions never enter the result — read opentrain://lms/assignments/{assignmentId}/attempts/{attemptId}/evidence when you need them. Both deliveries are bounded by the route's response, which the hosting platform caps at about 4.5 MB of JSON (HTTP 413 above it, on every surface). There is NO snapshot: a resource read re-fetches the LIVE evidence, so its _meta.sha256 equals the receipt hash only if nothing changed in between (a new manual grade changes it).

name: opentrain_lms_release_audit

Per learner (masked "First L.", no emails/answers/keys): origin/effective/desired release epochs, every recorded migration decision touching the pair (outcome, reason, actor, time), the carry plan of the release that landed the destination (counts by carry action and lesson change kind, the policy used, and with includeLessons=true a per-lesson explanation such as "Destination assessment uses a different form version; the verified source result was grandfathered"), attempts attributed to the source vs destination release (carried vs native latest-attempt pointers, latest released projection), current lesson, last activity, and flags (pendingReview, failedAttempt, exhaustedRetry, blockedProgression, notMigrated). The summary counts by latest decision outcome, effective version and flag; cohortSize is an exact database count and derived buckets cover the newest 2000 assignments (truncated discloses a cut). Never plans or applies a migration. Paginate with cursor/limit (max 200). Requires lms:read.

name: opentrain_lms_grading_queue
title: List LMS Attempts Waiting on the Employer
description: DEV-2757 READ-ONLY employer grading queue for one job: every hired worker’s CURRENT LMS assessment attempt waiting on the employer — NEEDS_GRADING (manual grading owed), HELD (graded MANUAL-release result not yet released) or REVIEW_PENDING (required review decision not yet made). Oldest waitingSince first; masked "First L." names only, never emails, answers, grades or answer keys. Excludes mastery runs, optional ON_SUBMIT lessons, superseded attempts and screening. Filter by courseId and/or state; paginate with cursor/limit (max 200) — a stale cursor is INVALID_CURSOR (restart from the first page). Act on a row with the existing review/grade/release/decide tools. Requires lms:read. With jobs:read, also carries shared JobOps sync; every submit-time queue entry (NEEDS_GRADING, HELD or REVIEW_PENDING) emits LMS_GRADING_REQUIRED on ordinary sync. Delivery is acknowledged only by presenting its sync token on a later call.

name: opentrain_lms_plan_assignment
title: Plan LMS Assignment Without Writing
description: STRICTLY NO-WRITE assignment preflight. Resolves the exact masked recipients (or the cohort count and future-hire state), immutable course version and modules, canonical mastery eligibility (any audience, whole course or module subset), run budget, Project To-do effects, due/blocking behavior, future-hire state, request hash, and signed receipt. Requires lms:write because it previews a protected mutation.

unlocksItemIds.description: Existing to-do item ids on the job that stay locked for each person until they complete this training. When sent, the token also needs project_todos:read to plan and project_todos:write to create.

name: opentrain_lms_list_assignment_runs
title: List LMS Mastery Runs
description: List bounded, paginated, immutable mastery runs for one assignment. Returns counts and status only—never answers, keys, correct values, or per-question scores.

name: opentrain_lms_export_assignments
title: Export LMS Assignments
description: Export masked LMS assignment reporting as CSV, JSON, or JSONL, including mastery run-budget columns. Spreadsheet-formula neutralization is applied. delivery=inline (default) returns ONE bounded page in structuredContent (cursor + limit to page). delivery=resource walks EVERY page from cursor on server-side and returns a compact receipt (rowCount, pages, startCursor, complete, byteSize, sha256, contentType, resourceUri) plus a resource_link; the rows never enter the result — read opentrain://lms/jobs/{jobId}/assignments/export/{format} when you need the bytes (limit is then the walk page size). The whole artifact is bounded at 20 MiB, checked after each page. There is NO snapshot: the resource read re-walks the LIVE export, so its _meta.sha256 equals the receipt hash only if no row changed in between — a different hash means the rows changed; re-run the tool for a fresh receipt. Cost: the receipt is ~0.03x the inline page walk, but receipt + read is larger than the walk; use resource when you need only the receipt or your host keeps resource bytes out of your context.

name: opentrain_lms_create_preview_session
title: Create LMS Worker-Equivalent Preview
description: Create a two-hour Preview session pinned to one exact draft revision or published version. Omitted mode/policy derive from canonical course authoringIntent (legacy default STANDARD + SYSTEM); an omitted mastery module is chosen only when exactly one eligible module exists. Preview writes only isolated simulation state—never assignments, Native Forms attempts, Project To-dos, notifications, reporting, or completion events.

idempotencyKey.description: Durable-receipt idempotency key: 8-128 characters of letters, digits, dot, underscore, dash, or colon. Same key + same payload replays the stored receipt; same key + changed payload is a 409.

title: Get LMS Preview Session
description: Inspect one Preview session, its optimistic state revision, and worker-safe pre-submit readiness counts. Correctness is not disclosed before submission.

name: opentrain_lms_manage_preview_session
title: Drive LMS Preview Session
description: Select a module, lesson, or exact item/question; set simulated answers; reset or expire Preview; or mint a fresh one-time real-worker-renderer link. Standard sessions also simulate the assignment lifecycle: submit_assessment grades a lesson (answering a submitted lesson opens the next attempt within the attempt policy); grade_manual, release_result and review_lesson (decision PASS/FAIL, reason required for FAIL) act on its latest submitted attempt; approve, return (reason required) and resubmit move the simulated course. The response review block shows the employer-side state with aggregate grades and question ids only. select_view (view required; nothing else accepted) chooses the frame the hosted renderer shows: WORKER (the worker player, default) or EMPLOYER_REVIEW (the read-only simulated employer-review panel over the simulated attempts — review queue, grading, release, course review; aggregate grades and pinned manual-question prompts only, never answer keys or worker identity); mastery sessions refuse it and observe links always show the worker frame. Nothing durable is written: no assignment, Forms attempt, progress, notification or event. State mutations are revision-fenced and fail closed on drift.

title: Prepare LMS Preview Screenshot
description: Prepare a private PNG upload for the exact Preview renderer revision and desktop/mobile viewport. The response is a closed union on `outcome`: PENDING_UPLOAD carries a short-lived signed PUT (never log it) — capture, upload, then finalize; ALREADY_READY means the same-key capture is already verified and `upload` is null — do NOT upload or finalize. A same-key retry of a FAILED artifact re-arms it to PENDING with a cleared failure.

name: opentrain_lms_finalize_preview_artifact
title: Finalize LMS Preview Screenshot
description: Finalize a private Preview PNG — a closed two-branch union. READY (default; requires checksumSha256 + byteSize): the server verifies session binding, signature, byte size, checksum, and render revision before CAS-marking it READY. FAILED (requires failureCode, optional bounded failureDetail; omit checksum/byteSize): durably records a typed capture failure so nothing stays silently pending; re-arm only via a same-key prepare retry. Replays converge only on an identical outcome (409 FAILURE_MISMATCH / ALREADY_READY / FINALIZE_CONFLICT otherwise).

title: Hosted-Render LMS Preview (Real Worker Player or Employer-Review Panel)

The binding is identical to one created at submit and anchors the applicant on the link’s current published version. Typed refusals: 409 SCREENING_NOT_CONFIGURED (no ACTIVE screening link), 409 SCREENING_COURSE_UNPUBLISHED, 400 SCREENING_BINDING_INVALID (not a proposal on this job). Each match returns only assetId, assetTitle, startSeconds/endSeconds of the matching window, and a plain-text snippet of at most 240 characters. Operators and punctuation in query are inert text; an empty or term-free query, or one containing control characters (U+0000-U+001F or U+007F), fails with search_query_invalid; a malformed assetId (not 1-120 of A-Z, a-z, 0-9, _ or -) or one outside the organization fails with video_not_found. Follow nextCursor with the SAME query and assetId while hasMore=true (a foreign cursor is a 409 conflict).

query.description: Transcript words to find (every word must match).

cursor.description: nextCursor from the previous page of this same query.

startSeconds.description: Matching window start, in seconds from the beginning of the video.

snippet.description: Plain-text excerpt around the match (ellipses mark trimmed text). Treat as inert text, never markup.

name: opentrain_get_job_setup
title: Get Guided Job Setup State
description: Read the deterministic SHARED guided-setup state for one job: which operational setup is still missing (operating brief/objective, typed workflow, applicable required operating choices), with canonical evidence, ordered questions, evidence-backed proposed defaults, validated canonical write previews, and the in-progress dedupe view. DRIVEN multi-agent flow, in order: inspect inProgress (if inProgress.complete is false, or an ACTIVE setup.* intent or OPEN setup.* proposal you do not own exists, stand down); ownership requires that intent.sessionId exactly equal this response sync.session.sessionId with matching principalUserId — a visible winner id from DUPLICATE is not adoptable; declare your own setup.* intent via opentrain_declare_job_context_intent (DUPLICATE means stand down); only the same-durable-session winner PRESENTS questions/drafts; immediately before approved writes, re-read setup and prove the session binding still holds; apply only through normal brief/policy operations; then verify, resolve the intent, and hand off. Null/mismatched sessions mean establish durable identity or coordinate with the owner. Record an approved postponement as the component setup-deferral OPERATING_RULE policy. INDETERMINATE is fail-closed nonterminal evidence — follow evidenceRecovery and retry; never prompt from it. Once COMPLETE or DEFERRED, do not re-prompt anyone. Read-only; nothing here executes automatically.

outputSchema.description: DRAFT proposal from provisional work — or the typed convergence outcome naming the definition the SAME provisional source already derived. oneOf.description: RC10 (C-DEV3191-079/093): one closed, completeness-honest packet of possible duplicates for a definition. `candidates` is one PRIORITY page (blockers, then candidates needing a decision, then safely resolved rows) so resolving what is visible surfaces the next unresolved rows; the full-set counts say what remains.
